ato bahunāmeva madanādidravyāṇāṃ bahuprakāraprayogāṇāmupanyāso yukta iti bhāvaḥ| grahaṇāt upalambhāt| deho nānā sthūlakṛśādibhedena, bhaktiḥ icchā, avasthāśabdeneha rogāvasthaiva grāhyā, ādiśabdeneha sattvāhārayorgrahaṇam| bhūrivirecanaprayogopadarśanaprayojanāntaramapyāha- vicitretyādi| nānāvidhagandha-varṇa-rasatayā prayoge tatkālamuttarakālaṃ ca sukhārthamityarthaḥ| atha kiṃ prabhedānmadanaphalādīnāṃ ṣaṭprayogaśatāni bhavanti, yenādhikāḥ prayogā nābhidhīyanta ‘yena nādhikyaṃ prayogāṇāmabhidhīyate’ iti pā. ityāśaṅkyāha- asaṅkhyeyetyādi| vikalpamārgopadarśanārthamiti adhikaprayogakalpanāsamarthān bhiṣajaḥ prati etat ṣaṭprayogaśatopadarśanaṃ kartavyādhikaprayogakalpanāmārgopadarśakaṃ, tenāpare'pyatra prayogāḥ kalpanīyāḥ; granthe niḥśeṣaprayogānabhidhānaṃ prayogāṇāmasaṅkhyeyatvenāśakyatvādeva| anativistareṇa ṣaṭprayogaśatābhidhānaṃ mandabuddhisaṃvyavahārārthamiti bhāvaḥ| uktaṃ hyanyatra- “etāvanto hyalamalpabuddhīnāṃ vyavahārāya, buddhimatāṃ ca svālakṣaṇyānumānayuktikuśalānāmanuktārthajñānāya” (sū.a.4) iti||6||
tāni tu dravyāṇi deśa-kāla-guṇa-bhājana-sampadvīryabalādhānāt kriyāsamarthatamāni bhavanti||7||

samprati vamanavirecanadravyāṇāṃ deśādisampattyā guṇotkarṣaṃ darśayannāha- tānītyādi| deśādibhiścaturbhiḥ sampacchabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate| bhājanaṃ bheṣajasthāpanasthānam| vīryasya balaṃ vīryādhikatvameva||7||

trividhaḥ khalu deśaḥ- jāṅgalaḥ, ānūpaḥ, sādhāraṇaśceti| tatra jāṅgalaḥ paryākāśabhūyiṣṭhaḥ, tarubhirapi ca kadara-khadirāsanāśvakarṇa-dhava-tiniśa-śallakī-sāla-somavalka-badarī-tindukāśvattha-vaṭāmalakīvanagahanaḥ, anekaśamī-kakubha-śiṃśapāprāyaḥ, sthiraśuṣkapavanabalavidhūyamānapranṛtyattaruṇaviṭapaḥ, pratatamṛgatṛṣṇikopagūḍhatanukharaparuṣasikatāśarkarābahulaḥ, lāvatittiricakorānucaritabhūmibhāgaḥ, vātapittabahulaḥ, sthirakaṭhinamanuṣyaprāyo jñeyaḥ, athānūpo hintālatamālanārikelakadalīvanagahanaḥ, saritsamudraparyantaprāyaḥ, śiśirapavanabahulaḥ, vañjulavānīropaśobhitatīrābhiḥ saridbhirupagatabhūmibhāgaḥ, kṣitidharanikuñjopaśobhitaḥ, mandapavanānuvījitakṣitiruhagahanaḥ, anekavanarājīpuṣpitavanagahanabhūmibhāgaḥ, snigdhatarupratānopagūḍhaḥ, haṃsa-cakravāka-balākā-nandīmukha-puṇḍarīka-kādamba-madgu ‘... madgukoyaṣṭībhṛṅgarājapuṃskokilānunāditaḥ’ iti pā. -bhṛṅgarāja-śatapatra-mattakokilānunāditataruviṭapaḥ, sukumārapuruṣaḥ, pavanakaphaprāyo jñeyaḥ; anayoreva dvayordeśayorvīrudvanaspativānaspatyaśakunimṛgagaṇayutaḥ sthirasukumārabalavarṇasaṃhananopapannasādhāraṇaguṇayuktapuruṣaḥ sādhāraṇo jñeyaḥ||8||

deśādi samyag vyākurvannāha- tatra trividha ityādi| atra kecijjāṅgalādideśalakṣaṇagranthaṃ na paṭhanti, tattu janapadoddhvaṃsanīye paṭhitamiti kṛtvehānārṣaṃ vadanti| yaistu janapadoddhvaṃsanīye jāṅgalādilakṣaṇaṃ na paṭhyate, tairatra paṭhanīya evāyaṃ granthaḥ||8||

tatra deśe sādhāraṇe jāṅgale vā yathākālaṃ śiśirātapapavanasalilasevite same śucau pradakṣiṇodake śmaśāna-caitya-devayajanāgāra-sabhā-śvabhrārāma-valmīkoṣaravirahite kuśarohiṣāstīrṇe snigdhakṛṣṇamadhuramṛttike suvarṇavarṇamadhuramṛttike vā mṛdāvaphālakṛṣṭe'nupahate'nyairbalavattarairdrumairauṣadhāni jātāni praśasyante||9||

yathākālamiti yathākālaṃ śiśirādibhiḥ sevite deśe| śmaśānādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ virahitaśabdaḥ sambadhyate| devayajanenāgāraśabdaḥ sambadhyate| sabhā janamelakasthānam| na phālena kṛṣṭa iti aphālakṛṣṭe||9||

tatra yāni kālajātānyupāgatasampūrṇapramāṇa-rasavīrya-gandhāni ‘... nyāgatasampurṇapramāṇarasavīryagandhāni’ iti pā. kālātapāgnisalilapavanajantubhiranupahatagandha-varṇa-rasa-sparśa-prabhāvāṇi pratyagrāṇyudīcyāṃ diśi sthitāni; teṣāṃ śākhāpalāśamaciraprarūḍhaṃ varṣāvasantayorgrāhyaṃ, grīṣme mūlāni śiśire vā śīrṇaprarūḍhaparṇānāṃ, śaradi tvakkandakṣīrāṇi, hemante sārāṇi, yathartu puṣpaphalamiti; maṅgalācāraḥ kalyāṇavṛttaḥ śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ sampūjya devatā aśvinau gobrāhmaṇāṃśca kṛtopavāsaḥ prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā gṛhṇīyāt||10||

tatra yāni kālajātānītyanenaiva kālasampaducyate; kālajātānīti svakālabhūtāni| upāgatasampūrṇetyādinā pratyagrāṇītyantena guṇasampaducyate| pratyagrāṇīti sampūrṇaguṇatayā niṣpannāni| teṣāṃ śākhāpalāśamityādinā kālasampadamuktāṃ prapañcayati| śākhāgrahaṇenaiva tvagādīnāmapi grahaṇam| śīrṇaprarūḍhaparṇānāmiti cchedaḥ| grīṣme mūlāni śiśire veti kathanena yānyāgneyāni teṣāṃ mūlāni grīṣme, yāni saumyāni teṣāṃ mūlāni śiśire, grāhyāṇīti vyavasthāṃ sūcayati; uktaṃ hyanyatra- “saumyānyauṣadhāni saumyeṣvṛtuṣvādadīta, āgneyānyāgneyeṣu” (su.sū.a.36) iti| bheṣajagrahaṇavidhānamāha- maṅgaletyādi||10||

gṛhītvā cānurūpaguṇavadbhājanasthānyāgāreṣū ‘cānurūpaguṇavadbhājane saṃsthāpyāgāreṣu’ iti pā. prāgudagdvāreṣu nivātapravātaikadeśeṣu nityapuṣpopahārabalikarmavatsu, agni-salilopasveda-dhūma-rajo-mūṣaka-catuṣpadāmanabhigamanīyāni svavacchannāni śikyeṣvāsajya sthāpayet||11||
bhājanasampadamāha- gṛhītvetyādi| anurūpaguṇavadbhājanasthānīti anurūpaguṇavattā ca bhājanasya bheṣajasamānaguṇatayaiva| svavacchannānīti samyakpihitāni||11||

tāni ca yathādoṣaṃ prayuñjīta surā-sauvīraka-tuṣodaka-maireya-medaka-dhānyāmla ‘...dhānyaphaladadhyamlādibhirvāte’ iti pā. -phalāmla-dadhyamlādibhirvāte, mṛdvīkāmalaka ‘mṛdvīkāmadhumadhukaphāṇitakṣīrādibhiḥ’ iti pā. -madhu-madhuka-parūṣaka-phāṇitakṣīrādibhiḥ pitte, śleṣmaṇi tu madhu-mūtra-kaṣāyādibhirbhāvitānyāloḍitāni ca; ityuddeśaḥ| taṃ vistareṇa dravya-deha-doṣa-sātmyādīni ‘dravyadehadoṣasātmyādīn vasantādīṃśca’ iti pā. pravibhajya vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||12||

saṅkṣepeṇa madanaphalādīnāṃ vātādibhedena bhāvanāloḍanadravyāṇyāha- tāni ca yathādoṣaṃ prayuñjītetyādi| dhānyāmlaṃ kāñjikaṃ, phalāmlaṃ dāḍimarasādi| śleṣmaṇītyādau kaṣāyaśabdena śleṣmaharadravyakvātho'bhipretaḥ| uddeśa iti saṅkṣepābhidhānamityarthaḥ| dravya-deha-doṣa-sātmyādīnītyatra ādiśabdena prakṛtibalādīnāṃ grahaṇam||12||

vamanadravyāṇāṃ madanaphalāni śreṣṭhatamānyācakṣate, anapāyitvāt| tāni vasantagrīṣmayorantare ‘...rantarā puṣye'śvayuji mṛgaśirasi vā’ iti pā. puṣyāśvayugbhyāṃ mṛgaśirasā vā gṛhṇīyānmaitre muhūrte| yāni pakvānyakāṇānyaharitāni pāṇḍūnyakrimīṇyapūtīnyajantujagdhānyahrasvāni; tāni pramṛjya ‘pragṛhya kuśamūlairbaddhvā’ iti pā., kuśapuṭe baddhvā, gomayenālipya, yavatu(bu)ṣamāṣaśālikulatthamudgapalānāmanyatame ‘... mudgaparṇānā...’ iti pā. nidadhyādaṣṭarātram| ata ūrdhvaṃ mṛdūbhūtāni madhviṣṭagandhānyuddhṛtya śoṣayet| suśuṣkāṇāṃ phalapippalīruddharet ‘phalānāṃ pippalīruddharet’ iti pā.| tāsāṃ ghṛtadadhimadhupalalavimṛditānāṃ punaḥ śuṣkāṇāṃ navaṃ kalaśaṃ supramṛṣṭavālukamarajaskamākaṇṭhaṃ pūrayitvā svavacchannaṃ svanuguptaṃ śikyeṣvāsajya ‘...ṣvavasṛjya’ iti pā. samyak sthāpayet||13||

vamanadravyāṇāmityādinā madanaphalasya prādhānyopadarśanapūrvakaṃ prayogavidhimāha| anapāyitvāditi vamanadravyāntarāpekṣayā'lpavyāpattikatvāt| antare iti madhye, sa ca grīṣmavasantayorantarvartikatipayadinānyeva madhyo jñeyaḥ| aśvayuk aśvinī| maitre muhūrta iti śivabhujagamitrādīnāṃ madhye mitradevatāke, evaṃ maitre muhūrte| palānāmiti rāśīnām| madhuvadiṣṭagandho yeṣāṃ tāni, yāni madhviṣṭagandhāni bhavanti tāni grāhyāṇīti darśayati| phalapippalīriti madanaphalamadhyagatāni pippalīsaṃsthānāni bījāni| tāsāmityādi pūraṇavācakaśabdayogāt karaṇe ṣaṣṭhī| svanuguptamiti kṛtarakṣāvidhānam||13||

atha cchardanīyamāturaṃ dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā snehasvedopapannaṃ śvaśchardayitavyamiti grāmyānūpaudakamāṃsarasa-kṣīra-dadhi-māṣa-tila-śākādibhiḥ samutkleśitaśleṣmāṇaṃ vyuṣitaṃ jīrṇāhāraṃ pūrvāhṇe kṛtabalihomamaṅgalaprāyaścittaṃ nirannamanatisnigdhaṃ yavāgvā ghṛtamātrāṃ pītavantaṃ, tāsāṃ phalapippalīnāmantarnakhamuṣṭiṃ yāvadvā sādhu manyeta jarjarīkṛtya yaṣṭimadhukaṣāyeṇa kovidāra-karbudāra-nīpa-vidula-bimbī-śaṇapuṣpī-sadāpuṣpī-pratyakpuṣpī-kaṣāyāṇāmanyatamena vā rātrimuṣitaṃ vimṛdya pūtaṃ madhusaindhavayuktaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇaṃ śarāvaṃ mantreṇānenābhimantrayet- ‘oṃ brahmadakṣāśvirudrendrabhūcandrārkānilānalāḥ| ṛṣayaḥ sauṣadhigrāmā bhūtasaṅghāśca pāntu te| rasāyanamivarṣīṇāṃ devānāmamṛtaṃ yathā| sudhevottamanāgānāṃ bhaiṣajyamidamastu te’| ityevamabhimantryodaṅmukhaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ vā''turaṃ pāyayecchleṣmajvaragulmapratiśyāyārtaṃ viśeṣeṇa punaḥ punarāpittāgamanāt, tena sādhu vamati; hīnavegaṃ tu pippalyāmalaka-sarṣapa-vacākalkalavaṇoṣṇodakaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ pravartayedāpittadarśanāt| ityeṣa sarvaśchardanayogavidhiḥ||14||

dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā snehasvedopapannamityanena abhyaṅge kriyamāṇe snehasahacaritasvedopapādanaṃ dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā vidhīyate, “tryahāvaraṃ saptadinaṃ paraṃ tu snigdho naraḥ svedayitavya iṣṭaḥ” (si.a.1) ityanena pānaprayujyamānasnehasya saptarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā prakarṣa ucyate iti na virodhaḥ| etaccābhyaṅgasvedasahitasnehasvedakaraṇaṃ pānasnehāntadivasamārabhya kriyate, tena snehapānaviśrāmadinena samaṃ dvyahatryahapūraṇamabhyaṅgasnehasahitasvedaprayogasya bhavati| snehapānācca yadviśrāmadinam, “ekāhoparatastadvadbhuktvā pracchardanaṃ pibet” (sū.a.13) ityanenoktaṃ, tathaivehāpi| kaphotkleśakāribhojanamāha- śvaśchardayitavyamityādinā| śva iti parasminnahni| vyuṣitamiti rātrimatikrāntam| nirannamiti padacchedaḥ| anatisnigdhamityādinā vamanadina eva ghṛtamātrāyuktayavāgūpānapūrvakaṃ vamanamanatisnigdhapuruṣaviṣayaṃ brūte| anye tu pūrvadina evānatisnigdhasya ghṛtamātrāṃ ‘ghṛtamātrāyuktayavāgūpānamāhuḥ’ iti pā. pītavata eva yavāgvāḥ pānamāhuḥ, “peśalairvividhairannairdoṣānutkleśya dehinaḥ| snigdhasvinnāya vamanaṃ dattaṃ samyak pravartate|| athāparedyuḥ pūrvāhṇe sādhāraṇe kāle vamanadravyakaṣāyakalkacūrṇasnehānāmanyatamasya” (su.ci.a.33) ityādi suśrutokteḥ| antarnakhamuṣṭimiti antarīkṛtanakhamuṣṭiparimāṇam| yāvadvā sādhu manyetetyanena mātrāyā baladoṣādibhedenāsthiratvamityāha| yaṣṭīmadhukasya kovidārādiṣu vicchedapāṭha uttaraprayogeṣu kovidārāderyaṣṭīmadhuvirahitasya grahaṇārthaḥ| kovidāraḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ, sa śaradi puṣpati; karbudārastu kāñcanāraḥ, sa vasante puṣpati; nīpaḥ kadambaḥ, vidulaḥ vetasaḥ, śaṇapuṣpī ghaṇṭāravā, sadāpuṣpī arkapuṣpikā, pratyakpuṣpī apāmārgaḥ| rātrimuṣitaṃ vimṛdya pūtamiti śṛtakaṣāyāt kaṣāyāntaropadarśakaṃ pakṣāntaraṃ; kiṃvā, kaṣāyapāna eva śītakaṣāyavidhānamihocyate| pūrṇaṃ śarāvamiti maṅgalārthaṃ pūrṇakumbhavat| punaḥ punariti yāvat pittāgamanaṃ na bhavati tāvat punaḥ punaḥ kaṣāyaṃ pibedityarthaḥ| anyatrāpyuktaṃ- “pittāntamiṣṭaṃ vamanaṃ virekādardhaṃ” (si.a.1) ityādi| vamanāyogakārakahīnavegapravṛttipratikārārthamāha- hīnavegamityādi||14||
sarveṣu tu madhusaindhavaṃ kaphavilayanacchedārthaṃ vamaneṣu vidadhyāt| na coṣṇavirodho madhunaśchardanayogayuktasya, avipakvapratyāgamanāddoṣanirharaṇācca||15||

yadyapi ca ghreyādivamanayogeṣu madhusaindhavayogo na bhavati, tathā'pi ‘sarveṣu’ iti padaṃ bāhulyārtham| vamanārthakaṣāye uṣṇe madhuprakṣepo virodhitvānna yujyate, uktaṃ hi- “madhūṣṇamuṣṇārtamathavā” (sū.a.27) ityādi, evamāśaṅkya samādhānamāha na coṣṇavirodho madhuna ityādi| avipakvapratyāgamanādityanena pacyamānaṃ madhūṣṇayuktaṃ virudhyeteti darśayati| doṣanirharaṇācceti madhūṣṇaviruddhamapi vamanayoge uṣṇe iṣyate, tasya doṣanirharaṇādeva na virodho bhavatīti darśayati| evaṃ bastiprayoge'pi madhuna uṣṇāvirodho varṇanīyaḥ| etena yaṣṭīmadhvādinavadravyakṛtairnavabhiḥ kaṣāyairnavayogāḥ||15||

phalapippalīnāṃ dvau dvau bhāgau kovidārādikaṣāyeṇa triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ srāvayet, tena rasena tṛtīyaṃ bhāgaṃ piṣṭvā mātrāṃ harītakībhirbibhītakairāmalairvā tulyāṃ vartayet, tāsāmekāṃ dve vā pūrvoktānāṃ kaṣāyāṇāmanyatamasyāñjalimātreṇa vimṛdya balavacchleṣmaprasekagranthijvarodarāruciṣu pāyayediti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||16||

phalapippalīnāṃ dvau bhāgāvityādau phalapippalīnāṃ bhāgatrayaṃ kartavyaṃ; tatra bhāgadvayaṃ ṣaḍguṇena kovidārādikaṣāyeṇa kṣāraparisrāvaṇavidhivadekaviṃśativārān parisrāvaṇīyam| kovidārādīnāṃ cāṣṭānāmaṣṭau kaṣāyāḥ pṛthak parisrāvaṇe prayoktavyāḥ| yena ca kaṣāyeṇa ‘taiśca kaṣāyaiḥ’ iti pā. phalapippalībhāgadvayaṃ parisrāvya haritakyādiparimāṇā mātrā tṛtīyabhāgaphalapippalīkalkasya kriyate tenaiva kaṣāyeṇa mātrāyogāḥ ‘tenaiva kaṣāyeṇa mātrāyogāḥ’ ityayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate; evamaṣṭau harītakyādimātrayā nirdiṣṭāḥ phalapippalīyogā bhavanti| mātrāvikalpaśca doṣabalādivikalpakṛto jñeyaḥ| samānaṃ pūrveṇeti pūrvayogavadiha snehasvedābhimantraṇādividhānaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ| evamanyatrāpi pūrvavacchabdārtho jñeyaḥ||16||

phalapippalīkṣīraṃ, tena vā kṣīrayavāgūmadhobhāge raktapitte hṛddāhe ca; tajjasya vā dadhna uttarakaṃ kaphaccharditamakaprasekeṣu ‘...prasekeṣu pūrṇaṃ śarāvaṃ’ iti pā.; tasya vā payasaḥ śītasya santānikāñjaliṃ pitte prakupite uraḥkaṇṭhahṛdaye ca tanukaphopadigdhe, iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||17||

phalapippalyā kṣīrapākavidhinā sādhitaṃ kṣīraṃ phalapippalīkṣīram; ayameko yogaḥ| teneti phalapippalīsādhitakṣīreṇa| tajjasyeti phalapippalīkṣīrajātasya dadhnaḥ| uttarakamiti saram| santānikā kṣīroparisthaḥ styāno bhāgaḥ||17||
phalapippalīśṛtakṣīrānnavanītamutpannaṃ phalādikalkakaṣāyasiddhaṃ kaphābhibhūtāgniṃ viśuṣyaddehaṃ ‘viśuṣkadehaṃ viśuṣyamāṇaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca mātrayā pāyayediti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||18||
phalādīni phala-jīmūtakekṣvāku-dhāmārgava-kuṭaja-kṛtavedhanāni ṣaṭ| ete kṣīrayogacatuṣṭayena ghṛtayogena ca samaṃ pañca yogā adhyāyasaṅgrahe vaktavyā||18||

phalapippalīnāṃ phalādikaṣāyeṇa triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ suparibhāvitena puṣparajaḥprakāśena cūrṇena sarasi sañjātaṃ ‘sañjātaṃ’ iti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate bṛhatsaroruhaṃ sāyāhne'vacūrṇayet, tadrātrivyuṣitaṃ prabhāte punaravacūrṇitamuddhṛtya haridrākṛsarakṣīrayavāgūnāmanyatamaṃ saindhavaguḍaphāṇitayuktamākaṇṭhaṃ pītavantamāghrāpayet sukumāramutkliṣṭapittakaphamauṣadhadveṣiṇamiti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||19||
phalapippalīnāṃ phalādikaṣāyeṇetyādinā ekaṃ ghreyayogamāha| puṣparajaḥprakāśeneti puṣpadhūlisadṛśena| haridrābhidhānaḥ kṛśaro haridrākṛśaraḥ||19||

phalapippalīnāṃ bhallātakavidhiparisrutaṃ ‘bhallātakavidhisrutaṃ’ iti pā. svarasaṃ paktvā phāṇitībhūtamātantulībhāvāllehayet; ātapaśuṣkaṃ vā cūrṇīkṛtaṃ jīmūtakādikaṣāyeṇa pitte kaphasthānagate pāyayediti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||20||
bhallātakavidhiparisrutamiti rasāyanoktabhallātakasnehagrahaṇavidhānena parisrutaḥ svaraso grāhyaḥ| phāṇitayogo'yamekaḥ| ātapaśuṣkaṃ vetyādinā cūrṇayogo'pyekaḥ||20||
phalapippalīcūrṇāni pūrvavat phalādīnāṃ ‘kovidārādīnāṃ’ iti pā. ṣaṇṇāmanyatamakaṣāyasrutāni vartikriyāḥ phalādikaṣāyopasarjanāḥ ‘kovidārādikaṣāyopasarjanāḥ’ iti pā. peyā iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||21||

phalapippalīcūrṇānītyādau phalādiṣaṭkaṣāyabhedena kṛtatvāt ṣaḍ vartiprayogā jñeyāḥ| vartikriyāyāṃ caturguṇena kvāthena pākādvartyākāratā ‘śalākākāravartiḥ’ iti pā. kartavyā| atrāpi ca tathā lehādau ca sāmānyoktena madhuprakṣepo yuktaḥ; taṃ caike madhunaḥ pākavirodhānnānumanyante||21||

phalapippalīnāmāragvadha ‘phalapippalīṣvā...’ iti pā. -vṛkṣaka-svādukaṇṭaka-pāṭhā-pāṭalā-śārṅgeṣṭā-mūrvā-saptaparṇa-naktamāla-picumarda-paṭola-suṣavī-guḍūcī-somavalka-dvīpikānāṃ pippalī-pippalīmūla-hastipippalī-citraka-śṛṅgaverāṇāṃ cānyatamakaṣāyeṇa siddho leha iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||22||

phalapippalīnāmāragvadhetyādinā āragvadhādiviṃśatidravyakvāthabhedena kṛtatvādviṃśatirlehā jñeyāḥ| vṛkṣakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, svādukaṇṭakaḥ vikaṅkataḥ, śārṅgeṣṭā guñjā, suṣavī kāravellakaṃ, dvīpikā hiṃsrā, ‘kaṇṭakārī’ ityanye||22||

phalapippalīṣvelā-hareṇukā-śatapuṣpā-kustumburu-tagara-kuṣṭha-tvak-coraka-marubakāguru-guggulvelavāluka-śrīveṣṭaka-paripelava-māṃsī-śaileyaka-sthauṇeyaka-sarala-pārāvatapadyaśokarohiṇīnāṃ viṃśateranyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa sādhitotkārikā utkārikākalpena, modakā vā modakakalpena, yathādoṣarogabhakti prayojyā iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||23||

phalapippalīṣvityādinotkārikā modakāśca pratyekaṃ viṃśatiḥ| corakaḥ gandhadravyaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ, paripelavaṃ kaivartamustakaṃ, sthauṇeyakaḥ granthiparṇakaṃ, pārāvatapadī jyotiṣmatī, aśokarohiṇī aśokasadṛśapatrā latā, ‘kaṭurohiṇī’ ityanye| kecidatra sthauṇeyakaṃ parityajyāpākīpādyā viṃśatiṃ pūrayanti, apākīpādī svanāmakhyātā| utkārikākalpeneti sūdaśāstroktotkārikāvidhānena||23||
phalapippalīsvarasakaṣāyaparibhāvitāni tilaśālitaṇḍulapiṣṭāni tatkaṣāyopasarjanāni śaṣkulīkalpena vā śaṣkulyaḥ, pūpakalpena vā pūpāḥ iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||24||

etenaiva ca kalpena sumukha-surasa-kuṭheraka-kāṇḍīra-kālamālaka-parṇāsaka-kṣavaka-phaṇijjhaka-gṛñjana-kāsamarda-bhṛṅgarājānāṃ poṭekṣuvālikā-kālaṅkataka-daṇḍairakāṇāṃ cānyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa kārayet||25||

phalapippalīsvarasenetyādinā śaṣkulyapūpayoḥ pṛthageko yogaḥ| etenaiva ca kalpenetyādinā sumukhādipañcadaśadravyakaṣāyeṇa pṛthak śaṣkulyapūpayoḥ karaṇāt pañcadaśa yogā bhavanti| evaṃ militvā śaṣkulīpūpayoḥ pṛthak ṣoḍaśayogā bhavanti| poṭā ikṣugandhā; daṇḍairakā gundrākhyagulmaḥ, nalo vā||24-25||

tathā badaraṣāḍava-rāga-leha-modakotkārikā-tarpaṇa-pānaka-māṃsarasa-yūṣa-madyānāṃ ‘...yūṣamadyāni madanaphalaphāṇitenopasaṃsṛjya’ iti pā. madanaphalānyanyatamenopasṛjya yathādoṣarogabhakti dadyāt; taiḥ sādhu vamatīti||26||
tathā badaraṣāḍavetyādinā daśa yogāḥ| badarakṛtaḥ ṣāḍavo badaraṣāḍavaḥ||26||
madanaḥ karahāṭaśca rāṭhaḥ piṇḍītakaḥ phalam| śvasanaśceti paryāyairucyate tasya kalpanā||27||

madanasya vyavahārārthaṃ paryāyānāha- madanaḥ karahāṭaścetyādi| tasya kalpaneti ya evambhūtaiḥ paryāyairvyākhyātastasyeyaṃ kalpanā| asya ca paryāyābhidhānaṃ bhūriprayogeṣu vihitatvenābhyarhitatvājjñeyam| evamanyatrāpi paryāyābhidhāne prayojanaṃ varṇanīyam||27||
tatra ślokāḥ- nava yogāḥ kaṣāyeṣu, mātrāsvaṣṭau ‘vartiṣvaṣṭau’ iti pā., payoghṛte| pañca, phāṇitacūrṇe dvau ghreye, vartikriyāsu ṣaṭ||28||
viṃśatirviṃśatirlehamodakotkārikāsu ca| śaṣkulīpūpayoścoktā yogāḥ ṣoḍaśa ṣoḍaśa||29||
daśānye ṣāḍavādyeṣu trayastriṃśadidaṃ śatam| yogānāṃ vidhivaddiṣṭaṃ phalakalpe maharṣiṇā||30||
madanaphalayogānāṃ navādisaṅkhyotkarṣanirāsārthaṃ sukhasmaraṇārthaṃ ca tān saṅgraheṇāha- nava yogā ityādi| asya cārtho yathāsthānaṃ vyāhṛtaḥ||28-30||
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne madanakalpo nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ||1||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ kalpasthāne madanakalpo nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ||1||

div.head: jīmūtakakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athāto jīmūtakakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||2||

madanakalpānantaramanapāyitvenekṣvākvādidravyebhyaḥ prādhānyājjīmūtakasya jīmūtakalpo'bhidhīyate| evaṃ yathāyathaiṣāmanapāyitvaprakarṣaḥ, tathā tathā pūrvaniveśanaṃ jñeyam| tenāparavamanakalpānāmapyadhyāyasambandho'traivokto jñeyaḥ| madanaphalasya snehasvedādipūrvakatvavadihāpi kramo'tideśādunnetavyaḥ||1-2||
kalpaṃ jīmūtakasyemaṃ phalapuṣpāśrayaṃ śuṇu| garāgarī ca veṇī ca tathā syāddevatāḍakaḥ||3||
phalapuṣpāśrayamiti vacanena jīmūtasya patranālādiṣu vamanaprayogaṃ niṣedhayati| garāgarī cetyādi paryāyakathanam| jīmūtaḥ pītaghoṣakaḥ||3||
jīmūtakaṃ tridoṣaghnaṃ yathāsvauṣadhakalpitam| prayoktavyaṃ jvaraśvāsahikkādyeṣvāmayeṣu ca||4||

tridoṣaghnamiti yathāsvaṃ vātaharādidravyayuktaṃ, tathā vātādiharadravyakalpitaṃ ‘peyādikalpitaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca sat tridoṣaghnaṃ bhavati| hikkādyeṣviti ādyaśabdena kāsādīnāmurogatadoṣajanyānāṃ grahaṇam||4||
yathoktaguṇayuktānāṃ deśajānāṃ yathāvidhi| payaḥ ‘payaḥpuṣpeṣu nirvṛttaṃ’ iti pā. puṣpe'sya, nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā||5||
lomaśe kṣīrasantānaṃ, dadhyuttaramalomaśe| śṛte payasi dadhyamlaṃ jātaṃ ‘jāte’ iti pā. haritapāṇḍuke||6||
jīrṇānāṃ ca suśuṣkāṇāṃ nyastānāṃ bhājane śucau| cūrṇasya payasā śuktiṃ vātapittārditaḥ pibet||7||

yathoktayuktaguṇayuktānāmiti kālajatva-sampūrṇarasatvādiguṇayuktāni madanaphaloktaguṇadvārā'nusartavyāni| deśajānāmiti madanakalpoktapraśastabhūmijātānām| yathāvidhīti madanakalpoktavidhānagṛhītānām| payaḥ puṣpe ityeko yogaḥ| nirvṛtte ityādiko dvitīyo yogaḥ| nirvṛtte iti utpannamātre phale, tatra phalaiḥ kṣīraṃ sādhayitvā tena kṣīreṇa peyā sādhanīyā| romaśe ityādi tṛtīyaḥ| romaśe iti upagataromṇi phale, atrāpi romaśaphalasādhitakṣīrāt santānikā jñeyā| dadhyuttaramityādikaścaturtho yogaḥ, atrāpyupagataromāvasthaphalasādhitakṣīrasambhūtadadhisaro jñeyaḥ| śṛte payasītyādikaḥ pañcamaḥ| dadhyamlamiti amlāvasthaṃ dadhi jātam| haritapāṇḍuke iti haritapāṇḍvavasthāprāpte jīmūtakaphale| jīrṇānāmityādikaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ kṣīrayogaḥ| ete ca yogāḥ kṣīrasambandhena avidhīyamānakṣīrākārā api kṣīraprayogatvenaiva saṅgrahe ‘ṣaṭ kṣīre’ ityanena saṅgrahītavyāḥ||5-7||

div.ab: āsutya ca surāmaṇḍe mṛditvā prasrutaṃ pibet| kaphaje'rocake kāse pāṇḍuroge sayakṣmaṇi||8|| dve cāpothyāthavā trīṇi guḍūcyā ‘guḍūcyāmalakasya vā’ iti pā. madhukasya vā| kovidārādikānāṃ vā nimbasya kuṭajasya vā||9|| kaṣāyeṣvāsutaṃ pūtvā tenaiva vidhinā pibet| athavā''ragvadhādīnāṃ saptānāṃ pūrvavat pibet||10|| ekaikasya ‘ekaikaśaḥ’ iti pā. kaṣāyeṇa pittaśleṣmajvarārditaḥ|11|

āsutyetyādinā madirāyoga eka ucyate| āsutyeti niśāparyuṣitaṃ kṛtvā| atra yoge pakvajīmūtakaphalamevādhikṛtaṃ; tathā, uttarayogeṣvapi pakvameva phalamadhikṛtaṃ jñeyaṃ, “phalaṃ paryāgataṃ grāhyaṃ” ityautsargikavacanāt| dve cetyādinā dvādaśakaṣāyabhedād dvādaśayogā ucyante| tenaiva vidhineti madanakalpoktena sādhanavidhinā| athavetyādau āragvadhādisaptadravyakaṣāyabhedāt saptayogā bhavanti| āragvadhādayaḥ āragvadha-vṛkṣaka-svādukaṇṭaka-pāṭhā-pāṭali-śārṅgeṣṭā-mūrvāḥ (ka.a.1) pūrvādhyāyoktāḥ||8-10||-

ab.seg: mātrāḥ syuḥ ‘vartayaḥ’ iti pā. phalavaccāṣṭau kolamātrāstu tā matāḥ||11||

mātrāḥ syurityādinā'ṣṭau mātrāyogānāha| phalavaditi madanaphale yathā aṣṭau mātrāyogā uktāstathehāpi kartavyāḥ, viśeṣatastu etāḥ kolamātrāḥ kartavyāḥ, na tu phalavaddharītakyādipramāṇāḥ kartavyā ityarthaḥ||11||
jīvakarṣabhakekṣūṇāṃ śatāvaryā rasena vā| pittaśleṣmajvare dadyādvātapittajvare'thavā||12||
jīvaketyādinā caturo yogāḥ pānasādhanakaṣāyabhedāt||12||
tathā jīmūtakakṣīrāt samutpannaṃ pacedghṛtam| phalādīnāṃ kaṣāyeṇa śreṣṭhaṃ tadvamanaṃ matam||13||
tathetyādinā ghṛtayogamekamāha||13||
tatra ślokau- ṣaṭ kṣīre madirāmaṇḍe ‘madirāyoge’ iti pā. eko dvādaśa cāpare| sapta cāragvadhādīnāṃ kaṣāye'ṣṭau ca vartiṣu||14||
jīvakādiṣu catvāro ghṛtaṃ caikaṃ prakīrtitam| kalpe jīmūtakānāṃ ca ‘ye’ iti ‘te’ iti ca pā. yogāstriṃśannavādhikāḥ||15||
ṣaṭ kṣīre ityādinā saṅgrahārtho vyākṛta eva yathāsthānam||14-15||
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne jīmūtakakalpo nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ||2||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ kalpasthāne jīmūtakakalpo nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ||2||

div.head: ikṣvākukalpaḥ
div.ab: athāta ikṣvākukalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1|| iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||2|| siddhaṃ vakṣyāmyathekṣvākukalpaṃ yeṣāṃ praśasyate|3|
uktādhyāyasambandhādikṣvākukalpo'bhidhīyate| yeṣāṃ praśasyate ikṣvākukalpastān vakṣyāmīti yojyam||1-2||-
lambā'tha ‘lambā piṇḍaphalā tumbī kaṭukālābukī ca sā’ iti pā. kaṭukālābūstumbī piṇḍaphalā tathā||3|| ikṣvākuḥ phalinī caiva procyate tasya kalpanā|4|
lambetyādi paryāyakathanam||3||-
kāsaśvāsaviṣacchardijvarārte kaphakarṣite||4|| pratāmyati nare caiva vamanārthaṃ tadiṣyate|5|
tadiṣyate iti ikṣvākukalpanamiṣyate||4||-

apuṣpasya pravālānāṃ muṣṭiṃ prādeśasammitam||5|| kṣīraprasthe śṛtaṃ dadyāt pittodrikte kaphajvare| puṣpādiṣu ca catvāraḥ kṣīre jīmūtake yathā||6|| yogā haritapāṇḍūnāṃ surāmaṇḍena pañcamaḥ| phalasvarasabhāgaṃ ca triguṇakṣīrasādhitam||7|| uraḥsthite kaphe dadyāt svarabhede ca pīnase| jīrṇe madhyoddhṛte kṣīraṃ ‘jīrṇamadhyoddhṛtaṃ kṣīre’ iti pā. prakṣipettadyadā dadhi||8|| jātaṃ syāt sakaphe kāse śvāse vamyāṃ ca tat pibet| ajākṣīreṇa bījāni bhāvayet ‘bhāvitāni prayojayet’ iti pā. pāyayet ca||9|| viṣagulmodaragranthigaṇḍeṣu ślīpadeṣu ca| mastunā vā phalānmadhyaṃ pāṇḍukuṣṭhaviṣārditaḥ||10|| tena takraṃ vipakvaṃ vā sakṣaudralavaṇaṃ pibet|11|

apuṣpasyetyādinā ekaḥ kṣīrayogaḥ| apuṣpasyeti anutpannapuṣpasya| muṣṭiṃ prādeśasammitamiti pradeśinyā mūlaparyantakṛtamuṣṭiparimāṇam; evaṃ ca nātra muṣṭiśabdaḥ palavacanaḥ| kṣīraprasthe śṛtamiti vacanāt kṣīraprasthe yathoktamānamikṣvākumāvāpya caturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ dattvā kṣīraṃ sādhanīyam| puṣpādiṣvityādinā caturaḥ kṣīrayogānāha| jīmūtake yathā “payaḥ puṣpe'sya nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā| romaśe kṣīrasantānaṃ dadhyuttaramaromaśe” (ka.a.2) ityanenoktaṃ, tathehāpi yogacatuṣṭayaṃ karaṇīyam| haritetyādinā surāyogamāha| haritapāṇḍūnāmikṣvākuphalānāṃ surāmaṇḍe jīmūtakavadyogaḥ kartavyaḥ; jīmūtakavidhānātideśena “āsutya ca surāmaṇḍe muditvā prasrutaṃ pibet” (ka.a.2) iti granthoktavidhānamihāpi bhavati| phalasvarasetyādinā ṣaṣṭhaḥ kṣīrayogo'bhidhīyate| triguṇakṣīrasādhitamiti triguṇena kṣīreṇa sādhitaṃ; tacca caturguṇena toyena sādhanīyam| phalaśabdenātrekṣvākuphalamucyate| jīrṇe ityādinā saptamaḥ kṣīrayogaḥ| madhyoddhṛte iti uddhṛtamadhye| ajākṣīreṇetyādinā'ṣṭamaḥ kṣīrayogaḥ| tena takramityādinā takrayogaḥ| teneti tumbīphalamadhyena||5-10||-
tumbyā phalarasaiḥ śuṣkaiḥ sapuṣpairavacūrṇitam||11|| chardayenmālyamāghrāya gandhasampatsukhocitaḥ|12|

tumbyā ityādinā ghreyayogamāha| gandhasampatsukhocita iti gandhasampat sugandhavattvaṃ, tayā gandhasampadā sukhamucitamabhyastaṃ yena saḥ; avacūrṇitekṣvākuphalarasapuṣpaṃ ‘avacūrṇitamikṣvākuphalarasabhāvitaṃ’ iti pā. mālyamāghrāyaiva vamatyanabhyastadurgandha iti bhāvaḥ||11||-
bhakṣayet phalamadhyaṃ vā guḍena palalena ca||12|| ikṣvākuphalatailaṃ vā siddhaṃ vā pūrvavadghṛtam|13|

bhakṣayedityādinā vamanayogamekamāha| phalamadhyam ikṣvākuphalamadhyam| ikṣvākuphalakalkasādhitaṃ tailamikṣvākuphalatailam; ayameka eva tailayogaḥ| pūrvavaditi jīmūtakavat, tena “tathā jīmūtakakṣīrāt” (ka.a.2) ityādinoktavidhānena jīmūtakasthāne ikṣvākuphalaṃ dattveha ghṛtaṃ sādhanīyam||12||-
pañcāśaddaśavṛddhāni phalādīnāṃ yathottaram||13|| pibedvimṛdya bījāni kaṣāyeṣvāśataṃ pṛthak|14|

pañcāśadityādinā ṣaḍ vardhamānakayogānāha| pañcāśadārabhya daśakena vṛddhairikṣvākubījaiḥ śataṃ pūraṇīyam| tena ṣaḍyogā bhavanti| tāni ca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ madanaphalādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāmanyatamakaṣāyeṣvāsutya vimṛditāni pātavyāni ‘tena madanaphalādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ kaṣāye āsutāḥ santo vimṛditāḥ pātavyāḥ’ iti pā.| anye tu daśabījādārabhya pañcāśadbījaparyantaṃ doṣādyapekṣayā pātavyaṃ; tatra madanādikaṣāyabhedādeva yogabheda ityāhuḥ||13||-

ab.seg: yaṣṭyāhvakovidārādyairmuṣṭimantarnakhaṃ pibet||14||
yaṣṭyāhvetyādinā navakaṣāyayogānāha| tatra yaṣṭyāhvamekaṃ, kovidārādayo madanakalpoktā aṣṭau||14||

div.ab: kaṣāyaiḥ kovidārādyairmātrāśca ‘rvartayaḥ’ iti pā. phalavat smṛtāḥ|15|
kaṣāyairityādinā madanaphalasadṛśavidhā aṣṭau mātrālakṣitāḥ prayogā ucyante|15|-

bilvamūlakaṣāyeṇa tumbībījāñjaliṃ pacet||15|| pūtasyāsya trayo bhāgāścaturthaḥ ‘bhāgāstrayastrikaṭukasya ca’ iti pā. phāṇitasya tu| saghṛto bījabhāgaśca piṣṭānardhāṃśikāṃstathā ‘piṣṭvā hyardhāṃśikāṃstathā’ iti pā.||16|| mahājālinijīmūtakṛtavedhanavatsakān| taṃ lehaṃ sādhayeddarvyā ghaṭṭayanmṛdunā'gninā||17|| yāvat syāttantumattoye patitaṃ tu na śīryate| taṃ lihanmātrayā lehaṃ ‘kāle’ iti pā. pramathyāṃ ca pibedanu||18|| kalpa eṣo'gnimanthādau catuṣke pṛthagucyate|19|

bilvetyādinā eko lehaḥ, tathā ‘kalpa’ ityādinā catvāro lehā ante draṣṭavyāḥ, evaṃ pañca lehāḥ| añjaliḥ palacatuṣṭayam| atra ca “tataśca kuḍavaṃ yāvattoyamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet” iti vacanādbilvamūlakaṣāyasyāṣṭāvañjalayo deyāḥ, tataścaturbhāgāvaśeṣeṇa kuḍavadvayam| phāṇitam ardhaśṛta ikṣurasaḥ| ‘caturthaḥ phāṇitasya ca’ ityasya sthāne ‘trayastrikaṭukasya ca’ iti kecit paṭhanti| saghṛta iti ghṛtasyaiko bhāgaḥ| ardhāṃśikāniti ekabhāgārdhamānān pratyekaṃ mahājālinyādīn| mahājālinī pītakoṣātakī, kṛtavedhanaḥ ghoṣakabhedaḥ ‘jyotsnikā” iti khyātaḥ| yāvat syāttantumadityādinā lehapākalakṣaṇamāha; etacca lakṣaṇaṃ lehāntareṣvapi pācanīyeṣu jñeyam| na śīryate na vistīryate| pramathyāṃ ca pibedanviti atīsāracikitsite “pippalī nāgaraṃ dhānyaṃ” (ci.a.19) ityādinoktapramathyānāṃ madhye'nyatamapramathyākṛtaṃ kaṣāyaṃ pibedityarthaḥ| ‘pramathyāṃ ca’ ityasya sthāne kecit ‘manthaṃ cāpi’ iti paṭhanti| agnimanthādāviti pratyekamagnimantha-syonāka-pāṭalā-gambhārīmūlacatuṣkaṃ pañcamūlakathanaprastāve rasāyane kathitam||15-18||-
śaktubhirvā pibenmanthaṃ tumbīsvarasabhāvitaiḥ||19|| kaphaje'tha jvare kāse kaṇṭharogeṣvarocake|20|
śaktubhirityādinaiko manthayogaḥ||19||-

ab.seg: gulme mehe ‘śophe’ iti pā. praseke ca kalkaṃ māṃsarasaiḥ pibet| naraḥ sādhu vamatyevaṃ na ca daurbalyamaśnute||20||
gulme jvara ityādinā rasaikayogamāha| kalkam ikṣvākubījakalkam||20||
tatra ślokāḥ- payasyaṣṭau surāmaṇḍa-mastu-takreṣu ca trayaḥ| ghreyaṃ sapalalaṃ tailaṃ vardhamānāḥ phaleṣu ṣaṭ||21||
ghṛtamekaṃ kaṣāyeṣu navānye madhukādiṣu| aṣṭau vartikriyā lehāḥ pañca mantho ‘manthe rase tathā’ iti pā. rasastathā||22||
yogā ikṣvākukalpe ‘ikṣvākukalpe'smin’ iti pā. te catvāriṃśacca pañca ca| uktā maharṣiṇā samyak prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā||23||
payasyaṣṭāvityādisaṅgrahārtho vyākṛta eva| atra phaleṣviti madanaphalādiṣu| ghṛtaṃ yadyapi vardhamānapūrvapaṭhitaṃ, tathā'pi chandonurodhādiha paścāt paṭhitam||21-23||
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne ikṣvākukalpo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ||3||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne ikṣvākukalpo nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ||3||

div.head: dhāmārgavakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dhāmārgavakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||2||
uktasambandhāddhāmārgavakalpo'bhidhīyate||1-2||
karkoṭakī koṭhaphalā ‘kaṭuphalā’ iti pā. mahājālinireva ca| dhāmārgavasya paryāyā rājakośātakī tathā||3||
tatra karkoṭakītyādinā paryāyakathanam| dhāmārgavaḥ pītaghoṣakaḥ||3||

div.ab: gare gulmodare kāse vāte śleṣmāśayasthite| kaphe ca kaṇṭhavakrasthe kaphasañcayajeṣu ca||4|| rogeṣveṣu ‘rogeṣvetat’ iti pā. prayojyaṃ syāt sthirāśca guravaśca ye|5|
sthirāśca guravaśca ye ityatra ‘gadāḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ||4||-

ab.seg: phalaṃ puṣpaṃ pravālaṃ ca vidhinā tasya saṃharet||5||
vidhineti bheṣajagrahaṇoktena vidhinā||5||
pravālasvarasaṃ śuṣkaṃ kṛtvā ca ‘kṛtāśca’ iti pā. gulikāḥ pṛthak| kovidārādibhiḥ peyāḥ kaṣāyairmadhukasya ca||6||
pravāletyādinā navayogānāha| pravālasya svarasaḥ pravālasvarasaḥ| atra kovidārādikaṣāyairguḍikākaraṇaṃ pānaṃ ca jñeyam||6||

div.ab: puṣpādiṣu payoyogāścatvāraḥ ‘prayogāśca’ iti, ‘yathāyogāḥ’ iti ca pā. pañcamī surā| pūrvavat...|7|
puṣpādiṣvityādinā jīmūtakakalpavidhānena nirdiṣṭāścatvāraḥ kṣīraprayogāḥ, pañcamaśca surāyogo'tidiśyate; te ca ‘payaḥ puṣpe'sya’ (ka. a. 2) ityādinoktā jñeyāḥ| pūrvavaditi pūrveṇa sambadhyate|7|-
... jīrṇaśuṣkāṇāmataḥ kalpaḥ pravakṣyate||7|| madhukasya kaṣāyeṇa bījakaṇṭhoddhṛtaṃ phalam| saguḍaṃ vyuṣitaṃ rātriṃ kovidārādibhistathā||8|| dadyādgulmodarārtebhyo ye cāpyanye kaphāmayāḥ|9|

jīrṇaśuṣkāṇāmityādinā navakaṣāyayogānāha, tathā ‘jātyāḥ’ ityādinā ekādaśa kaṣāyayogān vakṣyati; evaṃ viṃśatiḥ kaṣāyayogāḥ saṅgrahe vakṣyamāṇāḥ pūryante| bījakaṇṭhoddhṛtaṃ phalamiti yatra bījāni baddhāni santi sa bījakaṇṭha uddhṛto yasmin tadbījakaṇṭhoddhṛtaṃ phalam| atra ca pūrvanipātāniyama āhitāgnyādipūrvanipātavadbodhyaḥ| evambhūtaṃ ca phalaṃ kaṣāyeṇa saguḍena pūritaṃ rātrivyuṣitaṃ kartavyam| uktaṃ hi jatūkarṇe- dhāmārgavakalpe- “dhāmārgavaphaleṣūddhṛtabījamadhyeṣu saguḍoṣitāḥ kovidārādikaṣāyā nava” iti| gulmināṃ cāvasthāyāṃ vamanaṃ hitameva, teneha gulmaviṣayatayā vamanopadarśanaṃ na virodhi||7-8||-

ab.seg: dadyādannena saṃyuktaṃ chardihṛdrogaśāntaye||9||
dadyādityādinā eko'nnayoga ucyate| anne ca dhāmārgavasya saṃyogenaiko yogaḥ||9||
cūrṇairvā'pyutpalādīni bhāvitāni prabhūtaśaḥ| rasakṣīrayavāgvāditṛpto ghrātvā vamet sukham||10||
cūrṇairityādinā ghreye ekayogamāha| utpalādīnāṃ cātra bhedo'vivakṣitaḥ utpalasyaika eva ghreyayogaḥ| atra ādiśabdena saugandhikapadmādīnāṃ grahaṇam| prabhūtaśaścūrṇairbhāvitānīti jñeyam||10||
cūrṇīkṛtasya vartiṃ vā kṛtvā badarasammitām| vinīyāñjalimātre tu pibedgo'śvaśakṛdrase ‘gośakṛto rase’ iti pā.||11||
pṛṣatarṣyakuraṅgāhvagajoṣṭrāśvatarāvike| śvadaṃṣṭrakharakhaṅgānāṃ caivaṃ peyā śakṛdrase ‘pṛṣatarṣyakuraṅgāśvataragokarṇarāsame| hariṇājaśvadaṃṣṭrāvisambhave ca śakṛdrase’ iti pā.||12||

cūrṇīkṛtasyetyādinā go'śvaśakṛdrase iti dvau yogau| tathā pṛṣatetyādidaśayogaiḥ samaṃ śakṛdrasayogasambandhāddvādaśa śakṛdyogā ucyante| pṛṣataḥ binducitritahariṇaḥ; ṛṣyaḥ nīlāṇḍaḥ, kuraṅgaḥ cañcalagatiḥ, aśvataraḥ vegasaraḥ, śvadaṃṣṭraḥ caturdaṃṣṭro mṛgaviśeṣaḥ||11-12||

div.ab: jīvakarṣabhakau vīrāmātmaguptāṃ śatāvarīm| kākolīṃ śrāvaṇīṃ medāṃ mahāmedāṃ madhūlikām||13|| ekaikaśo'bhisañcūrṇya saha dhāmārgaveṇa te| śarkarāmadhusaṃyuktā lehā hṛddāhakāsinām||14|| sukhodakānupānāḥ syuḥ pittoṣmasahite kaphe|15|

jīvaketyādinā daśa lehānāha| madhūlikā ‘markaṭahasta’ iti khyātā| atra leheṣu dhāmārgavāditaradravyacūrṇasya samānatvaṃ; madhuśarkarayośca tāvatī mātrā yāvatyā lehatvāpattirbhavati| pittoṣmasahite kaphe iti udyatoṣmaguṇena pittena yukte kaphe; anye tu pittoṣmaśabdena pittoṣmaṇā ‘pittakṛtaṃ’ iti pā. kṛtaṃ jvaramāhuḥ||13-14||-

ab.seg: dhānyatumburuyūṣeṇa kalkaḥ sarvaviṣāpahaḥ||15||

div.ab: dhānyetyādinaikaṃ kalkayogamāha| dhānyatumbarukvātha eva dhānyatumburuyūṣaḥ| uktaṃ hi jatūkaṇa “dhānyatumbururasena kalko viṣanut” iti||15|

jātyāḥ saumanasāyinyā rajanyāścorakasya ca| vṛścīrasya mahākṣudrasahāhaimavatasya ca||16|| bimbyāḥ punarnavāyā vā kāsamardasya vā pṛthak ‘punarnavākāsamardabimbīhaimavatasya ca| mahāsahākṣudrasahāvṛścīrāṇāṃ pṛthak pṛthak’ iti pā.| ekaṃ dhāmārgavaṃ dve vā kaṣāye parimṛdya tu||17|| pūtaṃ manovikāreṣu pibedvamanamuttamam|18|
jātyā ityādinā ekādaśakaṣāyayogānāha| jātī saumanasyāyinī, anye yūthikāṃ vadanti| vṛścīraḥ śvetapunarnavā| mahāsahā kṣudrasahā mudgamāṣaparṇyau| haimavatī vacā||16-17||-

ab.seg: tacchṛtakṣīrajaṃ sarpiḥ sādhitaṃ vā phalādibhiḥ||18||
tacchṛtetyādinaikaṃ ghṛtayogamāha||18||
tatra ślokau- pallave nava catvāraḥ kṣīra ekaḥ surāsave| kaṣāye viṃśatiḥ kalke daśa dvau ca śakṛdrase||19||
anna ekastathā ghreye daśa lehāstathā ghṛtam| kalpe dhāmārgavasyoktāḥ ṣaṣṭiryogā maharṣiṇā||20||
pallave navetyādisaṅgrahe vyutkramasaṅgrahābhidhānaṃ chando'nurodhāt| daśa dvau ceti dvādaśetyarthaḥ||19-20||
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne dhāmārgavakalpo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ||4||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne dhāmārgavakalpo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ||4||

div.head: vatsakakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athāto vatsakakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||2||
yathoktasambandhādvatsakakalpābhidhānam||1-2||
atha vatsakanāmāni bhedaṃ strīpuṃsayostathā| kalpaṃ cāsya pravakṣyāmi ‘nibodhemaṃ’ iti pā. vistareṇa yathātatham||3||
vatsakaḥ kuṭajaḥ śakro vṛkṣako girimallikā| bījānīndrayavāstasya tathocyante kaliṅgakāḥ||4||
bṛhatphalaḥ śvetapuṣpaḥ ‘sitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ’ iti pā. snigdhapatraḥ pumān bhavet| śyāmā cāruṇapuṣpā strī phalavṛntaistathā'ṇubhiḥ ‘phalapuṣpaiḥ’ iti pā.||5||
raktapittakaphaghnastu sukumāreṣvanatyayaḥ| hṛdrogajvaravātāsṛgvīsarpādiṣu śasyate||6||

vatsakanāmāni vyavahārārthaṃ strīpuruṣabhedaṃ cāha- athetyādi| atra vatsakastrīpuruṣabhedena yadyapi guṇabhedaḥ prayogabhedo vā na pratipāditaḥ, tathā'pi strīrūpavatsake'puṣpaphalatvādiviśiṣṭalakṣaṇayukte'pyaviśeṣeṇobhābhyāmevāmayanivṛttiḥ syādityetadarthamubhayorapi samānaguṇatā jñātavyā||3-6||

div.ab: kāle phalāni saṅgṛhyā tayoḥ śuṣkāṇi nikṣipet ‘saṅkṣipet’ iti pā.| teṣāmantarnakhaṃ muṣṭiṃ jarjarīkṛtya bhāvayet ‘tepayet’ iti, ‘temayet iti’ ca pā.||7|| madhukasya kaṣāyeṇa kovidārādibhistathā| niśi sthitaṃ vimṛdyaitallavaṇakṣaudrasaṃyutam||8|| pibettadvamanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pittaśleṣmanibarhaṇam|9|

kāle iti ucite kāle| śuṣkāṇīti pakvaśuṣkāṇi| teṣāmantarnakhamityādinā kaṣāyairnavayogānāha| kṣaudrasaindhavayogo yadyapi sarvavamaneṣveva sāmānyena vihitaḥ, tathā'pīha ‘lavaṇakṣaudrasaṃyutam’ iti vacanādutkarṣo lavaṇasaindhavayorabhidhīyate||7-8||-

aṣṭāhaṃ payasā''rkeṇa teṣāṃ cūrṇāni bhāvayet||9|| jīvakasya ‘jīmūtakakaṣāyeṇa’ iti pā. kaṣāyeṇa tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ pibet| phalajīmūtakekṣvākujīvantīnāṃ pṛthak tathā||10|| sarṣapāṇāṃ madhūkānāṃ lavaṇasyāthavā'mbunā|11|
aṣṭāhamityādinā pañca cūrṇayogānāha||9-10||-

ab.seg: kṛśareṇāthavā yuktaṃ vidadhyādvamanaṃ bhiṣak||11||
kṛśareṇetyādinā kṛśarayoga ucyate| atra ca indrayavacūrṇamadhikṛtatvādevocyate||11||
tatra ślokaḥ- kaṣāyairnava cūrṇaiśca pañcoktāḥ salilaistrayaḥ| ekaśca kṛśarāyāṃ syādyogāste'ṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ ‘kṛśarā'ṣṭādaśayogā vatsakasya nidarśitāḥ’ iti pā.||12||
kaṣāyairityādisaṅgrahaśloko vyākhyātārtha eva||12||
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne vatsakakalpo nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||5||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne vatsakakalpo nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||5||

div.head: kṛtavedhanakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṛtavedhanakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||2||
vamanakalpapāriśeṣyāt kṛtavedhanakalpo'bhidhīyate||1-2||
kṛtavedhananāmāni kalpaṃ cāsya nibodhata| kṣveḍaḥ kośātakī coktaṃ ‘jālī’ iti pā. mṛdaṅgaphalameva ca||3||
atyarthakaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ gāḍheṣviṣṭaṃ gadeṣu ca| kuṣṭhapāṇḍvāmayaplīhaśophagulmagarādiṣu||4||
gāḍheṣviti atyarthagāḍheṣu kuṣṭhādiṣu||3-4||

div.ab: kṣīrādi kusumādīnāṃ ‘kṣīrādikusumādīni’ iti pā. surā caiteṣu pūrvavat|5|

kṣīrādītyādinā kṣīrayogā ucyante| kṣīrayogacatuṣṭayaṃ madirāyogaṃ ca jīmūtakakalpavidhānātideśenāha| kṣīrādiśabdena kṣīrakṛtapeyā-kṣīrasantānikā-dadhyuttarāṇāṃ grahaṇam| ete ca saṅgrahe'kṣīrarūpā api kṣīravikāratayā kṣīraśabdenaiva gṛhītāḥ ‘kṣīre dvau dvau’ iti vacanena| kusumādīnāmiti kṛtavedhanasya puṣpādīnāṃ “payaḥ puṣpe'sya nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā| lomaśe kṣīrasantānaṃ dadhyuttaramalomaśe” (ka.a.2) iti jīmūtakavidhānoktānām| surā caiteṣu pūrvavaditi yathā jīmūtakakalpavidhānena kṣīrādayaḥ kartavyāstathā surā ca kartavyā|5|

ab.seg: suśuṣkāṇāṃ tu jīrṇānāmekaṃ ‘bījānāmekaṃ’ iti pā. dve vā yathābalam||5||
kaṣāyairmadhukādīnāṃ navabhiḥ phalavat pibet| kvāthayitvā phalaṃ ‘rasaṃ taṃ ca kṛtvā lehaṃ’ iti, ‘rasaṃ tasya paktvā lehaṃ’ iti ca pā. tasya pūtvā lehaṃ nidhāpayet||6||
kṛtavedhanakalkāṃśaṃ phalādyardhāṃśasaṃyutam ‘phalārdhārdhāṃśasaṃyutam’ iti pā.| pṛthak cāragvadhādīnāṃ trayodaśabhirāsutam||7||

suśuṣkāṇāmityādinā nava kaṣāyayogānāha| phalavaditi madanaphalaṃ yathā yaṣṭīmadhukādibhiḥ pīyate, tathaitadapi pātavyamityarthaḥ| eke navakaṣāyaprayogeṣu śeṣavidhipratyāyakaṃ lehaṃ paṭhanti- “kvāthayitvā rasaṃ tasya pūtvā lehaṃ nidhāpayet” ityādi, tacca saṅgatārtham| uktaṃ ca jatūkarṇe- “atra jīrṇabījānāṃ madanaphalavat kaṣāyairlehā bhavanti nava” iti| pṛthagityādinā trayodaśa kaṣāyayogānāha| evaṃ dvāviṃśatiḥ kaṣāyayogā bhavanti| āragvadhādayastrayodaśa madanakalpe “āragvadhavṛkṣaka ...” (ka.a.1) ityādinā guḍūcyantenoktā jñeyāḥ||5-7||

div.ab: śālmalīmūlacūrṇānāṃ ‘śālmalīmūlavṛntānāṃ’ iti pā. picchābhirdaśabhistathā|8|

śālmalītyādinā daśa picchāyogānāha| śālmalīmūlamādiḥ yeṣāṃ te śālmalīmūlāḥ śālmalyādayo vimānapaṭhitā daśa śālmalīśālmalakabhadraparṇyelāparṇyupodikoddāladhanvanarājādanopacitrāgopyantāḥ (vi.a.8); eṣāṃ cūrṇānāṃ picchābhiryuktyā kṛtatvenaiva daśa yogā jñeyāḥ| śālmalakaḥ śālmalībhedaḥ, rohitako vā; bhadraparṇī gambhārī; elāparṇī nāgabalā, ahiṃsretyanye; rājādanāṃ kṣīrikā, upacitrā dantī, gopī sārivā|8|

ab.seg: vartikriyāḥ ‘vartayaḥ phalavat ṣaṭ syuḥ’ iti pā. ṣaṭ phalavat, phalādīnāṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā||8||

vartikriyāḥ ṣaṭ phalavaditi “phalapippalīcūrṇāni pūrvavat” (ka.a.1) ityādinā granthena yā vartikriyā uktā madanakalpe, tadvadihāpi kṛtavedhanacūrṇānāṃ ṣaḍvartikriyāḥ kartavyāḥ| phalādīnāṃ ghṛtaṃ tathetyanena kṛtavedhanasādhitakṣīrādutthitaṃ navanītaṃ phalādikaṣāyeṇa sādhanīyaṃ madanaphalaghṛtavadityarthaḥ||8||
kośātakāni pañcāśat kovidārarase pacet| taṃ kaṣāyaṃ phalādīnāṃ kalkairlehaṃ punaḥ pacet||9||
kṣveḍasya tatra bhāgaḥ syāccheṣāṇyardhāṃśikāni tu| kaṣāyaiḥ kovidārādyairevaṃ ‘kovidārādyairaṣṭābhistaṃ pṛthak pibet’ iti pā. tat kalpayet pṛthak||10||
kośātakānītyādi| atraiva kvāthapādike kalke kartavye kṣveḍasya pūrṇo bhāgo deyaḥ, phalādīnāṃ ca pratyekaṃ kṣveḍādardhabhāgikatvam||9-10||

div.ab: kaṣāyeṣu phalādīnāmānūpaṃ piśitaṃ pṛthak| kośātakyā samaṃ paktvā rasaṃ salavaṇaṃ pibet||11|| phalādipippalītulyaṃ tadvat kṣveḍarasaṃ pibet|12|

kaṣāyeṣvityādinā sapta māṃsayogānāha| samamiti kośātakītulyaṃ māṃsam| atra pibedityantena ṣaṇmāṃsarasāḥ, phalādītyanena caikaḥ| phalādipippalītulyaṃ tadvadityanena phalādibhiḥ samaṃ māṃsam| tadvaditi vacanāt kośātakyāḥ kaṣāyeṇa sādhanīyam||11||-

ab.seg: kṣveḍaṃ kāsī kāsīti kāsavānityarthaḥ pibet siddhaṃ miśramikṣurasena ca||12||
ikṣurasayogamekamāha- kṣveḍamityādi| siddhamiti ikṣurasena miśritaṃ sat sādhitaṃ pibedityarthaḥ uktaṃ hi jatūkarṇe- “kṣveḍamikṣurase śṛtam” iti||12||
tatra ślokau- kṣīre dvau dvau surā caikā kvāthā dvāviṃśatistathā| daśa picchā ghṛtaṃ caikaṃ ṣaṭ ca vartikriyāḥ śubhāḥ||13||
lehe'ṣṭau sapta māṃse ca yoga ikṣurase'paraḥ| kṛtavedhanakalpe'smin ṣaṣṭiryogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ||14||
kṣīre dvau dvāvityādisaṅgrahaḥ| dvau dvāviti catvāraḥ||13-14||
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne kṛtavedhanakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ||6||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ kalpasthāne kṛtavedhanakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ||6||

div.head: śyāmātrivṛtkalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śyāmātrivṛtkalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||2||

vamanārthakalpanānantaraṃ virecanakalpeṣu vaktavyeṣu trivṛtāyā virecanadravyeṣu sukhavirecanatayā pradhānatvāt trivṛtkalpa evābhidhīyate| trivṛtābheda eva ca śyāmā, tena śyāmāyāstrivṛtāyāśca kalpaḥ śyāmātrivṛtkalpaḥ| yadyapi cāruṇamūlaiva trivṛdatrotkṛṣṭā vaktavyā, tathā'pyadhyāyasañjñāyāṃ śyāmāyā agre pāṭhenāśudoṣahantṛtayā śyāmāyāḥ prakarṣaṃ darśayati| ye cātra yogā vaktavyāste'ruṇayā vā śyāmayā vā ubhābhyāṃ vā doṣaśarīrādibalābalamavekṣya kartavyāḥ||1-2||
virecane trivṛnmūlaṃ śreṣṭhamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ‘…rmaharṣayaḥ’ iti pā.| tasyāḥ sañjñā guṇāḥ karma bhedaḥ kalpaśca vakṣyate||3||
virecane ityādau trivṛnmūlaśabdena śyāmamūlāyā aruṇamūlāyāśca sāmānyena mūlaṃ gṛhyate||3||
tribhaṇḍī trivṛtā caiva ‘śyāmā suvahā koṭarā tathā| trivṛt sarvānubhūtiśca’ iti pā. śyāmā kūṭaraṇā tathā| sarvānubhūtiḥ suvahā ‘saralā’ iti pā. śabdaiḥ paryāyavācakaiḥ||4||
paryāyatvena vācakaiḥ paryāyavācakaiḥ||4||
kaṣāyā madhurā rūkṣā vipāke kaṭukā ca sā| kaphapittapraśamanī raukṣyāccānilakopanī||5||
sedānīmauṣadhairyuktā vātapittakaphāpahaiḥ| kalpavaiśeṣyamāsādya ‘kalpe vaiśeṣyamāsādya’ iti pā. sarvarogaharā bhavet||6||

sedānīmityādi| vātāpahauṣadhayogena vātahantṛtvamavidyamānaṃ bhavati, kaphapittahantṛtvaṃ vidyamānamadhikaṃ bhavatīti jñeyam| kalpavaiśeṣyamiti kalpanāviśeṣam| sarvarogahareti vyastasamastasarvadoṣārabdharogaharā||5-6||
mūlaṃ tu dvividhaṃ tasyāḥ śyāmaṃ cāruṇameva ca| tayormukhyataraṃ ‘tayoḥ śreṣṭhataraṃ’ iti pā. viddhi mūlaṃ yadaruṇaprabham||7||
sukumāre śiśau vṛddhe mṛdukoṣṭhe ca tacchubham ‘taddhitam’ iti pā.| mohayedāśukāritvācchyāmā kṣiṇvīta mūrcchayet ‘śyāmā kaṇṭhaṃ kṣiṇotyapi’ iti pā.||8||
taikṣṇyāt karṣati hṛtkaṇṭhamāśu doṣaṃ haratyapi| śasyate bahudoṣāṇāṃ krūrakoṣṭhāśca ye narāḥ||9||

trivṛtayorbhedamāha- mūlaṃ tu dvividhamityādi| mukhyataramiti virecanakriyāyāmevāvyāpattikaratvācchreṣṭhataram| sukumārāḥ śiśavaśca yadyapyavirecanīyā uktāstathā'pi teṣāṃ vidhīyamānavirecane hitamiti jñeyam| mohayedityādinā śyāmamūlāyā guṇakarmaṇī brūte| kṣiṇvīteti dhātukṣayaṃ kuryāt||7-9||
guṇavatyāṃ tayorbhūmau jātaṃ mūlaṃ samuddharet| upoṣya prayataḥ śukle śuklavāsāḥ samāhitaḥ||10||
gambhīrānugataṃ ślakṣṇamatiryagvisṛtaṃ ca yat| tadvipāṭyoddharedgarbhaṃ ‘tadvipothyoddharedgarbha’ iti pā. tvacaṃ śuṣkāṃ nidhāpayet||11||

yadyapi madanakalpa eva guṇavadbhūmijātatvādi sāmānyena bheṣajānāmuktameva, tathā'pi gambhīrānugatatvādiviśeṣasya tatrānuktasyehābhidhāne sati tatprasaṅgāt tatkiñciducyate- guṇavatyāmityādi| śukle iti śuklapakṣe| gambhīrānugamiti dūrapraviṣṭam| uddharedgarbhamiti mūlasyāsthi uddharet| nidhāpayediti yathoktabhaiṣajyasthāpanavidhānena sthāpayet||10-11||

div.ab: snigdhasvinno virecyastu peyāmātroṣitaḥ ‘peyāmātrocitaḥ’ iti, ‘peyāmātrāśritaḥ’ iti ca pā. sukham|12|

peyāmātroṣita iti pūrvadine peyāmātrāhāratayā uṣitaḥ; yadyapi cānyatra virecanapūrvadineṣu tathaivāhāro niyamitaḥ- “snehavaddravamuṣṇaṃ ca tryahaṃ bhuktvā rasaudanam” (sū.a.13) ityanena, tathā'pi trivṛdvirecanaprayoge pūrvadine viśeṣavidhānāt peyādānaṃ jñeyam| kiñceyameva tadvacanāt snigdhoṣṇamāṃsarasasādhitā ca kriyamāṇā na pūrvoktasnehavaddravauṣṇamāṃsarasaudanaviruddhā bhavati|12|

ab.seg: akṣamātraṃ tayoḥ piṇḍaṃ vinīyāmlena nā pibet||12||
go'vyajāmahiṣīmūtrasauvīrakatuṣodakaiḥ| prasannayā triphalayā śṛtayā ca pṛthak pibet||13||
akṣamātramityādinā navabhiramlādibhirdravyairnavayogānāha| tayoriti śyāmātrivṛdaruṇatrivṛtayoḥ| etayośca militayoḥ pratyekaṃ ca prayogā iti prāgeva pratipāditam| amleneti kāñjikena||12-13||
ekaikaṃ saindhavādīnāṃ dvādaśānāṃ sanāgaram| trivṛddviguṇasaṃyuktaṃ ‘trivṛttriguṇasaṃyuktaṃ’ iti pā. cūrṇamuṣṇāmbunā pibet||14||

ekaikamityādinā saindhavādibhirdvādaśayogānāha| saindhavādayaśca dvādaśa rogabhiṣagjitīye (vi.a.8) lavaṇaskandhoktā jñeyāḥ| sanāgaramiti nāgarasahitaṃ sat pratyekaṃ saindhavādīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ dviguṇatrivṛtācūrṇayuktaṃ pātavyam||14||

div.ab: pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ maricaṃ gajapippalī| saralaḥ kilimaṃ hiṅgu bhārgī tejovatī tathā||15|| mustaṃ haimavatī pathyā citrako rajanī vacā| svarṇakṣīryajamodā ca śṛṅgaveraṃ ca taiḥ pṛthak||16|| ekaikārdhāṃśasaṃyuktaṃ pibedgomūtrasaṃyutam|17|
pippalītyādinā pippalyādidravyabhedena mūtre'ṣṭādaśayogānāha||15-16||-

ab.seg: madhukārdhāṃśasaṃyuktaṃ śarkarāmbuyutaṃ pibet||17||
madhuketyādinaikaḥ prayogaḥ| ayaṃ ca saṅgrahoktayoḥ ‘yaṣṭyāṃ dvau’ ityanayorekataraḥ||17||

div.ab: jīvakarṣabhakau medāṃ śrāvaṇīṃ karkāṭāhvayām| mudgamāṣākhyaparṇyau ca mahatīṃ śrāvaṇīṃ tathā||18|| kākolīṃ kṣīrakākolīmindrāṃ ‘kṣudrāṃ’ iti, ‘citrāṃ’ iti ca pā. chinnaruhāṃ tathā| kṣīraśuklāṃ payasyāṃ ca yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vidhinā pibet||19|| vātapittahitānyetānyanyāni tu kaphānile|20|
jīvaketyādinā caturdaśayogān tathā yaṣṭyāhvamityekaṃ cāha| ayaṃ ca saṅgrahoktayoḥ ‘yaṣṭyāṃ dvau’ iti dvayoranyataraḥ| kṣīraśuklā kṣīravidārī| indrā kokilākṣaḥ| payasyā arkapuṣpī||18-19||-
kṣīramāṃsekṣukāśmaryadrākṣāpīlurasaiḥ pṛthak||20|| sarpiṣā vā tayoścūrṇamabhayārdhāṃśikaṃ pibet|21|
kṣīretyādinā kṣīrādau sapta yogānāha| pīlu auttarapathikaṃ phalam||20||-

ab.seg: lihyādvā madhusarpirbhyāṃ saṃyuktaṃ sasitopalam||21||
ajagandhā tugākṣīrī vidārī śarkarā trivṛt| cūrṇitaṃ kṣaudrasarpirbhyāṃ līḍhvā sādhu viricyate||22||
sannipātajvarastambhadāhatṛṣṇārdito naraḥ| śyāmātrivṛtkaṣāyeṇa kalkena ca saśarkaram||23||
sādhayedvidhivallehaṃ lihyāt pāṇitalaṃ tataḥ| sakṣaudrāṃ śarkarāṃ paktvā kuryānmṛdbhājane nave||24||
kṣipecchīte ‘dadyācchīte’ iti pā. trivṛccūrṇaṃ tvakpatramaricaiḥ saha| mātrayā ‘lihyāttaṃ mātrayā lehaṃ’ iti pā. lehayedetadīśvarāṇāṃ virecanam||25||
kuḍavāṃśān ‘rasān kauḍavikānikṣu...’ iti pā. rasānikṣudrākṣāpīluparuṣakāt| sitopalāpalaṃ kṣaudrāt kuḍavārdhaṃ ca sādhayet||26||
taṃ lehaṃ yojayecchītaṃ trivṛccūrṇena śāstravit| etadutsannapittānāmīśvarāṇāṃ ‘etadutkṛṣṭapittānā...’ iti pā. virecanam||27||
śarkarāmodakān vartīrgulikāmāṃsapūpakān| anena vidhinā kuryāt paittikānāṃ virecanam||28||
pippalīṃ nāgaraṃ kṣāraṃ śyāmāṃ trivṛtayā saha| lehayenmadhunā sārdhaṃ śleṣmalānāṃ ‘ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ’ iti pā. virecanam||29||
mātuluṅgābhayādhātrīśrīparṇīkoladāḍimāt| subhṛṣṭān svarasāṃstaile sādhayettatra cāvapet||30||
sahakārāt kapitthācca madhyamamlaṃ ca yat phalam| pūrvavadbahalībhūte trivṛccūrṇaṃ samāvapet||31||
tvakpatrakeśarailānāṃ cūrṇaṃ madhu ca mātrayā| leho'yaṃ kaphapūrṇānāmīśvarāṇāṃ virecanam||32||

lihyādvā madhvityādinā'ṣṭau lehānāha| lihyādvetyādinā prathamo lehaḥ| ajagandhetyādinā dvitīyaḥ| ajagandhā ajamodā| śyāmātrivṛdityādinā tṛtīyo lehaḥ| atra śarkarātrivṛccūrṇābhyāṃ samābhyāṃ kvāthapādikābhyāṃ lehaḥ| sakṣaudrāmityādinā caturthaḥ| atra kṣaudrapāko yogamahimnā| trivṛccūrṇamātrāpādikatvaṃ tvakpatrādīnāṃ, saugandhamātraprayojanatvāt ‘trivṛccūrṇamatra pādikaṃ, tvakpatrādīni saugandhamātraprayojanatvādalpāni’ iti pā.| īśvarāṇāṃ virecanamiti vacanena sukumāratvādasnigdhaviṣayatāmasya darśayati, īśvarā hi prāyeṇa sukumārāḥ snigdhāśca bhavanti| kuḍavāṃśānityādiḥ pañcamaḥ| atra trivṛccūrṇamanirdiṣṭamānaṃ, tacca prakṣepanyāyāllehāt pādikaṃ kartavyam| utsannapittānām udbhūtapittānām| śarkaretyādinā sitāyogāṃścaturo'tideśānuguṇyāllehānāṃ madhya evāha| atra vartyādayo'pi śarkarākṛtā eva jñeyāḥ| anena vidhineti ikṣvādirasasaṃskāreṇa trivṛccūrṇayogena ca| pippalīṃ nāgaramityādinā ṣaṣṭho lehaḥ| madhyamiti amlakapitthasya madhyaṃ bhāgam| amlaṃ ca yat phalamiti mātuluṅgādi| pūrvavaditi kauḍavikatvaṃ mātuluṅgādirasānāṃ darśayati||21-32||
pānakāni rasān yūṣānmodakān rāgaṣāḍavān| anena vidhinā kuryādvirekārthaṃ kaphādhike||33||
pānakānītyādinā'tideśānuguṇyāt pānakādipañcayogānāha| rāgapradhānaḥ ṣāḍavo rāgaṣāḍavaḥ| anena vidhineti pūrvalehoktavidhinā||33||
bhṛṅgailābhyāṃ samā nīlī taistrivṛttaiśca śarkarā| cūrṇaṃ phalarasakṣaudraśaktubhistarpaṇaṃ pibet||34||
vātapittakaphottheṣu rogeṣvalpānaleṣu ca| nareṣu sukumāreṣu nirapāyaṃ virecanam||35||
bhṛṅgailābhyāmityādinā tarpaṇayogaṃ prathamamevāha, dvitīyastu tarpaṇayogo bhaviṣyatīti| bhṛṅgaṃ guḍatvak| taiśca śarkareti bhṛṅgalānīlītrivṛdbhiḥ| phalarasaḥ dāḍimarasaḥ||34-35||
śarkarātriphalāśyāmātrivṛtpippalimākṣikaiḥ| modakaḥ sannipātordhvaraktapittajvarāpahaḥ||36||
śarkaretyādinā modakaḥ prathamaḥ| tatra ca “modake dviguṇo guḍaḥ” iti vacanāt guḍaśarkarāṃ cūrṇāddviguṇāmicchanti||36||
trivṛcchāṇā matāstisrastisraśca triphalātvacaḥ| viḍaṅgapippalīkṣāraśāṇāstisraśca cūrṇitāḥ||37||
lihyāt sarpirmadhubhyāṃ ca modakaṃ vā guḍena tu| bhakṣayenniṣparīhārametacchodhanamuttamam ‘... metacchreṣṭhaṃ virecanam’ iti pā.||38||
gulmaṃ plīhodaraṃ śvāsaṃ ‘kāsaṃ’ iti pā. halīmakamarocakam| kaphavātakṛtāṃścānyān vyādhīnetahyapohati||39||
trivṛcchāṇā ityādineha modake ca yadyapi paṭhyate yogaḥ, tathā'pyasya lehenaiva grahaṇādayamaṣṭamo leho bhavati||37-39||

div.ab: viḍaṅgapippalīmūlatriphalādhānyacitrakān| maricendrayavājājīpippalīhastipippalīḥ||40|| lavaṇānyajamodāṃ ca cūrṇitaṃ kārṣikaṃ pṛthak| tilatailatrivṛccūrṇabhāgau cāṣṭapalonmitau||41|| dhātrīphalarasaprasthāṃstrīn guḍārdhatulāṃ tathā| paktvā mṛdvagninā khādedbadarodumbaropamān||42|| guḍān kṛtvā na cātra syādvihārāhārayantraṇā| mandāgnitvaṃ jvaraṃ mūrcchāṃ mūtrakṛcchramarocakam||43|| asvapnaṃ gātraśūlaṃ ca kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ bhramaṃ kṣayam| kuṣṭhārśaḥkāmalāmehagulmodarabhagandarān||44|| grahaṇīpāṇḍurogāṃśca hanyuḥ puṃsavanāśca te| kalyāṇakā iti khyātāḥ sarveṣvṛtuṣu yaugikāḥ||45|| iti kalyāṇakaguḍaḥ|46|

ab.seg: viḍaṅgetyādinā dvitīyo modakaḥ||40-45||

div.ab: vyoṣatvakpatramustailāviḍaṅgāmalakābhayāḥ ‘... malakān samān| trivṛto'ṣṭaguṇaṃ bhāgaṃ’ iti pā.| samabhāgā bhiṣagdadyāddviguṇaṃ ca mukūlakam||46|| trivṛto'ṣṭaguṇaṃ bhāgaṃ śarkarāyāśca ṣaḍguṇam| cūrṇitaṃ guḍikāḥ kṛtvā kṣaudreṇa palasammitāḥ||47|| bhakṣayet kalyamutthāya śītaṃ cānu pibejjalam| mūtrakṛcchre jvare vamyāṃ kāse śvāse bhrame kṣaye||48|| tāpe pāṇḍvāmaye'lpe'gnau śastā niryantraṇāśinaḥ| yogaḥ sarvaviṣāṇāṃ ca mataḥ śreṣṭho ‘śreṣṭhaṃ virecanam’ iti pā. virecane||49|| mūtrajānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ vidhijñenāvacāritaḥ|50|

vyoṣetyādinā tṛtīyo modakaḥ| ayaṃ modakastantrāntare ‘abhayādya’ iti khyātaḥ| mukūlakaṃ dantī| atra mukūlādīnāmekaikadravyāpekṣayā dvaiguṇyādi bhavati| madhu ca tāvanmātraṃ yāvatā modako bhavati| kecidatra vyoṣādimilitacūrṇāddantyādīnāṃ dvaiguṇyaṃ vadanti||46-49||-
pathyādhātryurubūkāṇāṃ prasṛtau dvau trivṛtpalam||50|| daśa tānmodakān kuryādīśvarāṇāṃ virecanam|51|
pathyetyādinā caturthaḥ||50||-

ab.seg: trivṛddhaimavatī śyāmā nīlinī hastipippalī||51||
samūlā pippalī mustamajamodā durālabhā| kārṣikaṃ nāgarapalaṃ guḍasya palaviṃśatim||52||
cūrṇitaṃ modakān kuryādudumbaraphalopamān| hiṅgusauvarcalavyoṣayavānībiḍajīrakaiḥ||53||
vacājagandhātriphalācavyacitrakadhānyakaiḥ| modakān veṣṭayeccūrṇaistān satumburudāḍimaiḥ||54||
trikavaṅkṣaṇahṛdbastikoṣṭhārśaḥplīhaśūlinām| hikkākāsāruciśvāsakaphodāvartināṃ śubhāḥ ‘hitāḥ’ iti pā.||55||
trivṛddhaimavatītyādinā pañcamo modakaḥ pūryate| veṣṭayediti avacūrṇayet||51-55||
trivṛtāṃ kauṭajaṃ bījaṃ pippalīṃ viśvabheṣajam| kṣaudradrākṣārasopetaṃ ‘samṛdvīkārasakṣaudraṃ’ iti pā. varṣāsvetadvirecanam||56||
trivṛddurālabhāmustaśarkarodīcyacandanam| drākṣāmbunā sayaṣṭyāhvasātalaṃ jaladātyaye||57||
trivṛtāṃ citrakaṃ pāṭhāmajājīṃ saralaṃ vacām| svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca hemante piṣṭvā tūṣṇāmbunā pibet||58||
śarkarā trivṛtā tulyā grīṣmakāle virecanam| trivṛttrāyantihapuṣāḥ sātalāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm ‘hapuṣāṃ saptalāṃ śyāmāṃ dravantīṃ kaṭurohiṇīm’ iti pā.||59||
svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca sañcūrṇya gomūtre bhāvayettryaham| eṣa sarvartuko yogaḥ snigdhānāṃ maladoṣahṛt||60||
trivṛcchyāmā durālambhā vatsakaṃ hastipippalī| nīlinī triphalā mustaṃ kaṭukā ca sucūrṇitam||61||
sarpirmāṃsarasoṣṇāmbuyuktaṃ pāṇitalaṃ tataḥ| pibet sukhatamaṃ ‘pibedetatsarvakālaṃ’ iti pā. hyetadrūkṣāṇāmapi śasyate||62||
tryūṣaṇaṃ triphalā hiṅgu kārṣikaṃ trivṛtāpalam| sauvarcalārdhakarṣaṃ ca palārdhaṃ cāmlavetasāt||63||
taccūrṇaṃ śarkarātulyaṃ madyenāmlena vā pibet| gulmapārśvārtinutsiddhaṃ jīrṇe cādyādrasaudanam||64||

trivṛtāṃ kauṭajamityādinā ṣaḍṛtuvihitān yogān rūkṣāṇāmapi śasyate ityantenāha| sātalā carmakaśā| jaladātyaye śaradi| hemante yadyapi prabalaśītavāte virecanaṃ niṣiddhaṃ, tathā'pi vyādhiviṣayavihitaṃ virecanametajjñeyam| sarvartukayogau anukte ṛtau vasantādau ca jñeyau| trivṛcchyāmetyādiko'pi sarvartuko yogaḥ| tryūṣaṇamityādiścūrṇayogo dvitīyaḥ||56-64||

div.ab: trivṛtāṃ triphalāṃ dantīṃ saptalāṃ vyoṣasaindhavam| kṛtvā cūrṇaṃ tu saptāhaṃ bhāvyamāmalakīrase||65|| tadyojyaṃ tarpaṇe yūṣe piśite rāgayuktiṣu|66|
trivṛtāṃ triphalāmityādikastarpaṇayogaḥ| evaṃ sarvartukayogena samaṃ dvau tarpaṇayogau bhavataḥ||65||-

ab.seg: tulyāmlaṃ trivṛtākalkasiddhaṃ gulmaharaṃ ghṛtam||66||
śyāmātrivṛtayormūlaṃ pacedāmalakaiḥ saha| jale tena kaṣāyeṇa ‘niryūheṇa tayoryuktyā’ iti pā. paktvā sarpiḥ pibennaraḥ||67||
śyāmātrivṛtkaṣāyeṇa siddhaṃ sarpiḥ pibettathā| sādhitaṃ vā payastābhyāṃ sukhaṃ tena viricyate||68||

tulyāmlamityekaṃ ghṛtaṃ, śyāmetyādi dvitīyaṃ, śyāmātrivṛtkaṣāyeṇetyādi tṛtīyam| sādhitaṃ cetyādinā kṣīrayogamekamāha| ghṛtena kṣīreṇa ca ghṛtena kṣīreṇa vaikena militvā catvāro ghṛtakṣīrairbhavanti||66-68||
trivṛnmuṣṭīṃstu sanakhānaṣṭau droṇe'mbhasaḥ pacet ‘jale droṇe trivṛnmuṣṭīnaṣṭau tu sanakhān pacet’ iti pā.| pādaśeṣaṃ kaṣāyaṃ taṃ pūtaṃ guḍatulāyutam||69||
snigdhe sthāpyaṃ ghaṭe kṣaudrapippalīphalacitrakaiḥ| pralipte madhunā ‘vidhinā’ iti pā. māsaṃ jātaṃ tanmātrayā pibet||70||
grahaṇīpāṇḍurogaghnaṃ gulmaśvayathunāśanam| surāṃ vā trivṛtāyogakiṇvāṃ ‘trivṛtākiṇvāṃ pibettatkvāthasaṃyutām’ iti pā. tatkvāthasaṃyutām||71||
trivṛnmuṣṭīnityādinā prathamā surā, surāṃ vetyādinā dvitīyā, evaṃ dvau surāyogau bhavataḥ| trivṛdyogayuktaṃ kiṇvaṃ yasyāṃ sā tathā||69-71||
yavaiḥ śyāmātrivṛtkvāthasvinnaiḥ kulmāṣamambhasā| āsutaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ palle jātaṃ sauvīrakaṃ pibet||72||
bhṛṣṭān vā satuṣāñchuddhān ‘kṣuṇṇān’ iti pā. yavāṃstaccūrṇasaṃyutān| āsutānambhasā tadvat pibejjātaṃ tuṣodakam||73||

yavairityādinā sauvīrakatuṣodake prāha| etau dvau kāñjikayogau| kulmāṣa utsvinnayavapiṣṭakam| palle iti dhānyādirāśau| taccūrṇasaṃyutāniti trivṛccūrṇasaṃyutān| tadvaditi ṣaḍahaṃ palle sthitāna||72-73||
tathā madanakalpoktān ṣāḍavādīn pṛthagdaśa| trivṛccūrṇena saṃyojya virekārthaṃ prayojayet||74||
tathetyādinā ṣāḍavādiyogān daśāha| daśa ṣāḍavādayo “badaraṣāḍavarāgalehamodakotkārikātarpaṇaśākamāṃsarasayūṣamadyānāṃ” (ka.a.1) iti granthena madanakalpoktāḥ||74||
bhavataścātra- tvakkeśarāmrātakadāḍimailāsitopalāmākṣikamātuluṅgaiḥ| madyaistathā'mlaiśca manonukūlairyuktāni deyāni virecanāni||75||
śītāmbunā pītavataśca tasya siñcenmukhaṃ chardivighātahetoḥ| hṛdyāṃśca mṛtpuṣpaphalapravālānamlaṃ ca dadyādupajighraṇārtham||76||
samprati daśottaraṃ yogaśatamabhidhāya vāntinirāsārthaṃ kṛtyatrayeṇa samaṃ virecanaprayogānāha- tvakkeśaretyādi||75-76||
tatra ślokāḥ- eko'mlādibhiraṣṭau ca daśa dvau saindhavādibhiḥ| mūtre'ṣṭādaśa yaṣṭyāṃ ‘yaṣṭyā’ iti pā. dvau jīvakādau caturdaśa||77||
kṣīrādau sapta lehe'ṣṭau catvāraḥ sitayā'pi ca| pānakādiṣu pañcaiva ṣaḍṛtau pañca modakāḥ||78||
catvāraśca ghṛte kṣīre dvau cūrṇe tarpaṇe tathā| dvau madye kāñjike dvau ca daśānye ṣāḍavādiṣu||79||
śyāmāyāstrivṛtāyāśca kalpe'smin samudāhṛtam| śataṃ daśottaraṃ siddhaṃ yogānāṃ paramarṣiṇā||80||
eko'mlādibhirityādisaṅgraho vyaktārthaḥ| yaṣṭyāṃ dvāviti ‘yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vidhinā’ iti jīvakādāvekaḥ, madhuketyādinā cāparaḥ||77-80||
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne śyāmātrivṛtkalpo nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ||7||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne śyāmātrivṛtkalpo nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ||7||

div.head: caturaṅgulakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaścaturaṅgulakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||2||
śyāmātrivṛtkalpānantaraṃ mṛduvirecanatvasāmānyāccaturaṅgulakalpo'bhidhīyate||1-2||
āragvadho rājavṛkṣaḥ śampākaścaturaṅgulaḥ| pragrahaḥ kṛtamālaśca karṇikāro'vaghātakaḥ||3||
vyavahārārthaṃ paryāyānāha- āragvadha ityādi||3||
jvarahṛdrogavātāsṛgudāvartādirogiṣu| rājavṛkṣo'dhikaṃ pathyo mṛdurmadhuraśītalaḥ||4||
bāle vṛddhe kṣate kṣīṇe sukumāre ca mānave| yojyo ‘deyaḥ’ iti pā. mṛdvanapāyitvādviśeṣāccaturaṅgulaḥ||5||
adhikaṃ pathya iti jvarādiṣu viśeṣeṇa virecanaprayoge hitaḥ||4-5||
phalakāle ‘recanārthe pariṇataṃ phalaṃ tasyāharedbudhaḥ’ iti pā. phalaṃ tasya grāhyaṃ pariṇataṃ ca yat| teṣaṃ guṇavatāṃ bhāraṃ ‘jātaṃ’ iti, ‘sāraṃ’ iti ca pā. sikatāsu nidhāpayet||6||
saptarātrāt samuddhṛtya śoṣayedātape bhiṣak| tato majjānamuddhṛtya śucau bhāṇḍe nidhāpayet||7||
phalakāle iti ucitaphalakāle| teṣāmiti phalānām| bhāramiti bhūridravyopalakṣaṇam| majjānamiti phalamajjānam||6-7||

div.ab: drākṣārasayutaṃ dadyāddāhodāvartapīḍite| caturvarṣamukhe bāle yāvaddvādaśavārṣike||8|| caturaṅgulamajjñastu prasṛtaṃ vā'thavā'ñjalim|9|
drākṣetyādiḥ prathamo yogaḥ| caturvarṣamukhe bāle yāvaddvādaśavārṣike ityanenāsya prayogasya caturvarṣādarvāgūrdhvaṃ ca dvādaśavarṣādavaśyatayā yaugikatvaṃ niṣedhayati||8||-

ab.seg: surāmaṇḍena saṃyuktamathavā kolasīdhunā||9||
dadhimaṇḍena vā yuktaṃ ‘samyak’ iti pā. rasenāmalakasya vā| kṛtvā śītakaṣāyaṃ taṃ ‘vā’ iti pā. pibet sauvīrakeṇa vā||10||
surāmaṇḍeneti dvitīyaḥ| athavā kolasīdhuneti tṛtīyaḥ| kolakṛtaḥ sīdhuḥ kolasīdhuḥ| sauvīrakeṇa vetyantena yogatrayamaparaṃ vyaktam||9-10||
trivṛto ‘trivṛnmajjñostathā kalkaṃ tatkaṣāyeṇa vā pibet’ iti pā. vā kaṣāyeṇa majjñaḥ kalkaṃ tathā pibet| tathā bilvakaṣāyeṇa lavaṇakṣaudrasaṃyutam||11||

trivṛto vā kaṣāyeṇa majjñaḥ kalkaṃ tathā pibediti saptamaḥ| tathetyādinā'ṣṭamaḥ| etatkalkakaṣāyayordvayaṃ ‘kaṣāye yogadvayam’ iti pā. jatūkarṇe'pyuktameva- ‘trivṛdbilvakaṣāyābhyāṃ sakṣaudralavaṇau dvau’ iti| tenātra pāṭhāntaraṃ na pramāṇam| saṅgrahe ca kariṣyati- ‘kaṣāye ca trivṛto bilvakasya ca’ iti||11||
kaṣāyeṇāthavā tasya trivṛccūrṇaṃ guḍānvitam| sādhayitvā śanairlehaṃ lehayenmātrayā naram||12||
kaṣāyeṇetyādiko leho navamaḥ||12||
caturaṅgulasiddhādvā kṣīrādyadudiyādghṛtam| majjñaḥ kalkena dhātrīṇāṃ rase tatsādhitaṃ pibet||13||
caturaṅguletyādinā prathamaṃ ghṛtam| majjña iti caturaṅgulamajjñaḥ||13||
tadeva daśamūlasya kulatthānāṃ yavasya ca| kaṣāye sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ kalkaiḥ śyāmādibhiḥ pibet||14||
tadevetyādinā ca dvitīyaṃ ghṛtam| śyāmādibhiriti madanakalpapaṭhitairnavabhiḥ ‘śyāmātrivṛddantī ... ’ (ka.a.1) ityādibhiḥ||14||
dantīkvāthe'ñjaliṃ majjñāḥ śampākasya guḍasya ca| dattvā māsārdhamāsasthamariṣṭaṃ pāyayeta ‘pāyayedbhiṣak’ iti pā. ca||15||
dantītyādinā'riṣṭayogamāha| guḍasya cāñjalimiti sambandhaḥ| māsārdhamāsasthamiti sārdhamāsastham||15||
yasya yat pānamannaṃ ‘pānamamlaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca hṛdyaṃ svādvatha vā kaṭu| lavaṇaṃ vā bhavettena yuktaṃ dadyādvirecanam||16||
yasya yadityādinā'nuktamaparāparasādhanaṃ vidhatte| hṛdyena hi virecanayogasya priyatā syāt| pānamannaṃ ceti hṛdyamityādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate||16||

tatra ślokāḥ drākṣārase surāsīdhvordadhni cāmalakīrase| sauvīrake kaṣāye ca trivṛto bilvakasya ‘sauvīrake'tha trivṛtaḥ kaṣāye tilvakasya ca’ iti, ‘sauvīrake kaṣāyābhyāṃ bilvaśampākayostathā’ iti ca pā. ca||17||
lehe'riṣṭe ghṛte dve ca yogā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ| caturaṅgulakalpe'smin sukumārāḥ sukhodayāḥ||18||
drākṣetyādisaṅgraho vyaktaḥ||17-18||
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne caturaṅgulakalpo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ||8||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne caturaṅgulakalpo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ||8||

div.head: tilvakakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātastilvakakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||2||
caturaṅgulavattilvakasyānapāyitvāccaturaṅgulakalpānantaraṃ tilvakakalpo'bhidhīyate||1-2||
tilvakastu mato lodhro bṛhatpatrastirīṭakaḥ| tasya mūlatvacaṃ śuṣkāmantarvalkalavarjitām||3||
cūrṇayettu tridhā kṛtvā dvau bhāgau ścotayettataḥ| lodhrasyaiva kaṣāyeṇa tṛtīyaṃ tena bhāvayet||4||
bhāgaṃ taṃ daśamūlasya punaḥ ‘kaṣāye bhāvitaṃ punaḥ’ iti pā. kvāthena bhāvayet| śuṣkaṃ cūrṇaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā tata ‘snigdhasvinne pradāpayet’ iti pā. ūrdhvaṃ prayojayet||5||

antarvalkalavarjitāmiti tilvakasyāntarvalkalaṃ kaṭhinaṃ bhavati, tadarthaṃ tadvarjanam| ścotayediti vacanena ṣaḍguṇadraveṇaikaviṃśativārān srāvayediti jñeyaṃ, madanaphalakalpe evambhūtasyaiva srāvaṇasya dṛṣṭatvāt| bhāvanāvidhiśca nirantaraṃ vyākṛta eva||3-5||
dadhitakrasurāmaṇḍamūtrairbadarasīdhunā ‘dadhimaṇḍasurāmaṇḍa...’ iti pā.| rasenāmalakānāṃ vā tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ pibet||6||
dadhimaṇḍetyādinā pibedityantena pañca yogāḥ||6||

div.ab: meṣaśṛṅgyabhayākṛṣṇācitrakaiḥ salile śṛte| marujān sunuyāttacca jātaṃ sauvīrakaṃ yadā||7|| bhavedañjalinā tasya lodhrakalkaṃ pibet sadā|8|
meṣaśṛṅgītyādinā viśiṣṭasauvīrakeṇa yoga ekaḥ| marujā bhṛṣṭayavāḥ||7||-

surāṃ lodhrakaṣāyeṇa jātāṃ pakṣasthitāṃ pibet||8|| dantīcitrakayordroṇe salilasyāḍhakaṃ pṛthak| samutkvāthya guḍasyaikāṃ tulāṃ lodhrasya cāñjalim||9|| āvapettat paraṃ pakṣānmadyapānāṃ ‘madyapānādvi...’ iti pā. virecanam|10|
surāmityādinā surāyogamāha| dantītyādinaikamariṣṭayogamāha| dantīcitrakayorāḍhakaṃ pṛthak saliladroṇe pacet| tilvakacūrṇamāvāpaḥ||8-9||-
kampillakakaṣāyeṇa ‘tilvakasya kaṣāyeṇa’ iti pā. daśakṛtvaḥ subhāvitām||10|| mātrāṃ kampillakasyaiva kaṣāyeṇa punaḥ pibet|11|
kampillaketyādinā kampillakayogamāha| kampillakaḥ guṇḍārocanikā| mātrāmiti tilvakacūrṇamātrām||10||-

ab.seg: caturaṅgulakalpena leho'nyaḥ kārya eva ca||11||
triphalāyāḥ kaṣāyeṇa sasarpirmadhuphāṇitaḥ| lodhracūrṇayutaḥ siddho lehaḥ śreṣṭho ‘śreṣṭhaṃ virecanam’ iti pā. virecane||12||
tilvakasya kaṣāyeṇa kalkena ca saśarkaraḥ| saghṛtaḥ sādhito lehaḥ sa ca śreṣṭho ‘śreṣṭhaṃ virecanam’ iti pā. virecane||13||

caturaṅguletyādinā prathamo lehaḥ| caturaṅgulakalpeneti ‘kaṣāyeṇāthavā tasya’ (ka.a.8) ityādinoktavidhānena| tenātra tilvakakvāthena guḍānvitatrivṛccūrṇaṃ paktvā lehaḥ kartavyaḥ| triphalāyā ityādinā dvitīyo lehaḥ| tilvakasyetyādinā tṛtīyaḥ||11-13||
aṣṭāṣṭau trivṛtādīnāṃ muṣṭīṃstu sanakhān pṛthak| droṇe'pāṃ sādhayet pādaśeṣe prasthaṃ ghṛtāt pacet||14||
piṣṭaistaireva bilvāṃśaiḥ samūtralavaṇairatha| tato mātrāṃ pibet kāle śreṣṭhametadvirecanam||15||
lodhrakalkena mūtrāmlalavaṇaiśca pacedghṛtam| caturaṅgulakalpena sarpiṣī dve ca sādhayet||16||

aṣṭāṣṭāvityādinā prathamaṃ ghṛtam| sanakhāniti vidyamānanakhān| atra trivṛdādigṛhītalodhrasya ‘trivṛtādigṛhīte lodhre lodhrasya pradhānatvāt’ iti pā. pradhānatvāddviguṇo bhāgo bhavati| uktaṃ hi jatūkarṇe- “trivṛdādidviguṇo lodhrakvāthaḥ” iti| samabhāgatve tu lodhraprayogatvasya kena viśeṣaḥ syāt, tasmād yathāvyākhyātameva sādhu| lavaṇamapyatra palāṃśameva| lodhretyādi dvitīyaṃ ghṛtam| caturaṅguletyādinā ghṛtadvayamatidiśyate| evaṃ ghṛtena catvāro yogā bhavanti| caturaṅgulaghṛte ca “caturaṅgulasiddhāt” (ka.a.8) ityādinā, tathā “tadeva daśamūlasya” (ka.a.8) ityādinā prokte jñeye; tathā ca caturaṅgulakalpena lodhrādinā dve lodhraghṛte bhavataḥ||14-16||
tatra ślokau- pañca dadhyādibhistvekā surā sauvīrakeṇa ca| eko'riṣṭastathā yoga ekaḥ kampillakena ca||17||
lehāstrayo ghṛtenāpi catvāraḥ samprakīrtitāḥ| yogāste lodhramūlānāṃ kalpe ṣoḍaśa darśitāḥ||18||
pañca dadhyādibhirityādisaṅgraho vyaktaḥ||17-18||
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne tilvakakalpo nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ||9||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne tilvakakalpo nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ||9||

div.head: sudhākalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ sudhākalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||2||

ṣoḍaśasaṅkhyaprayogābhidhāyakatilvakakalpānantaraṃ yathākramamadhikasaṅkhyāprayogābhidhānakramādviṃśatiyogābhidhāyakasudhākalpo'bhidhīyate; itaścānantaramatiriktasaṅkhyābhidhānakrameṇaiva ūnacatvāriṃśatprayogābhidhāyakasaptalāśaṅkhinīkalpo'bhidhāsyate||1-2||
virecanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sudhā tīkṣṇatamā matā| saṅghātaṃ hi bhinattyāśu doṣāṇāṃ kaṣṭavibhramā||3||
tasmānnaiṣā mṛdau koṣṭhe prayoktavyā kadācana| na doṣanicaye cālpe sati mārgaparikrame ‘cānyaparikrame’ iti pā.||4||

virecanānāmiti virecanadravyāṇām| kaṣṭavibhrameti duḥkhasādhyavibhramajanikā| tasmāditi atitīkṣṇatvāt kaṣṭavibhramatvācca| sati mārgaparikrama iti upakramamārgāntare sati na sudhā prayoktavyā, tena gatyantarāsambhava eva sudhā prayoktavyetyarthaḥ||3-4||

div.ab: pāṇḍurogodare gulme kuṣṭhe dūṣīviṣārdite| śvayathau madhumehe ca doṣavibhrāntacetasi||5|| rogairevaṃvidhairgrastaṃ jñātvā saprāṇamāturam| prayojayenmahāvṛkṣaṃ samyak sa hyavacāritaḥ||6|| sadyo harati ‘nudati’ iti pā. doṣāṇāṃ mahāntamapi sañcayam|7|

pāṇḍurogetyādau madhumehaśabdena pramehā evocyante; viśiṣṭastu vātikamadhumeho'sādhya eva, tena taṃ prati virecanopadeśo'narthaka eva syāt; madhumehaśabdaśca yathā pramohamātra eva vartate tat pratipāditameva pramehacikitsite| doṣavṛddhyā vibhrāntaṃ ceto yasmin tasmin doṣavibhrāntacetasi unmāde| saprāṇamiti balavantam||5-6||-

ab.seg: dvividhaḥ sa mato'lpaiśca bahubhiścaiva kaṇṭakaiḥ||7||
sutīkṣṇaiḥ kaṇṭakairalpaiḥ pravaro bahukaṇṭakaḥ| sa nāmnā snugguḍā nandā sudhā nistriṃśapatrakaḥ||8||
tau ‘taṃ’ iti pā. vipāṭyāharet kṣīraṃ śastreṇa matimān bhiṣak| dvivarṣaṃ vā trivarṣaṃ vā śiśirānte viśeṣataḥ||9||

pravaro bahukaṇṭaka iti anatitīkṣṇatayā'lpakaṇṭakamahāvṛkṣataḥ śreṣṭha ityarthaḥ| tāviti svalpakaṇṭakabahukaṇṭakau mahāvṛkṣau| yadyapi madanakalpe “śaradi tvakkandakṣīrāṇi” (ka.a.1) ityuktaṃ, tathā'pi sudhāyā ‘sudhāṃ prāpya’ iti pā. atra śiśirānte kṣīragrahaṇamapavādarūpaṃ jñeyam| śiśirasya śeṣā divasāḥ śiśirāntāḥ||7-9||

div.ab: bilvādīnāṃ bṛhatyā vā kaṇṭakāryāstathaikaśaḥ| kaṣāyeṇa samāṃśaṃ taṃ kṛtvā'ṅgāreṣu śoṣayet||10|| tataḥ ‘kolapramāṇāṃ guṭikāṃ pibet sauvīrakeṇa tām’ iti pā. kolasamāṃ mātrāṃ pibet sauvīrakeṇa vā| tuṣodakena kolānāṃ rasenāmalakasya vā||11|| surayā dadhimaṇḍena mātuluṅgarasena vā|12|

bilvādīnāmiti bilvādipañcamūlasya| aṅgāreṣu śoṣayediti aṅgāroparisthitapātrasthaṃ tat sudhākṣīraṃ bilvādīnāmanyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa samānaṃ śoṣaṇena kaṭhinaṃ kuryāt; tataḥ kolamātrā guṭikāḥ kāryāḥ, tataḥ sauvīrakādīnāmanyatamena pātavyā| evaṃ sauvīrakādibhedāt sapta yogā bhavanti; tathā'tra bilvādikaṣāyasya bhedena bhedo na vivakṣitaḥ||10-11||-

ab.seg: sātalāṃ kāñcanakṣīrīṃ śyāmādīni kaṭutrikam ‘phalatrikam’ iti pā.||12||
yathopapatti saptāhaṃ sudhākṣīreṇa bhāvayet| kolamātrāṃ ghṛtenātaḥ pibenmāṃsarasena vā||13||

sātalāmityādinā vātasādhanaghṛtamāṃsarasabhedādyogadvayamāha| sātalā carmakaśā| śyāmādigrahaṇenaiva sātalāyāmapi labdhāyāṃ pṛthak sātalābhidhānamekayā'pi sātalayā kṛtasudhāyogasya prādhānyakhyāpanārtham||12-13||
tryūṣaṇaṃ triphalāṃ dantīṃ citrakaṃ trivṛtāṃ tathā| snukkṣīrabhāvitaṃ samyagvidadhyādguḍapānakam||14||
tryūṣaṇamityādinā pānakayogamāha| guḍapānakamiti guḍasaṃskṛtapānakam||14||
trivṛtāragvadhaṃ dantīṃ śaṅkhinīṃ saptalāṃ samam| gomūtre rajanīṃ kṛtvā ‘niśi sthitaṃ gavāṃ mūtre’ iti pā. śoṣayedātape tataḥ||15||
saptāhaṃ bhāvayitvaivaṃ snukkṣīreṇāparaṃ punaḥ| saptāhaṃ bhāvayecchuṣkaṃ tatastenāpi bhāvitam||16||
gandhamālyaṃ tadāghrāya ‘samāghrāya’ iti pā. prāvṛtya paṭameva ca| sukhamāśu viricyante mṛdukoṣṭhā narādhipāḥ||17||
trivṛtetyādinā ghreyayogamāha| gomūtre rajanīṃ kṛtveti rajanīṃ vyāpya gomūtre sthāpayitvā| paṭameveti yathoktavidhibhāvitaṃ paṭamāvṛtyetyarthaḥ||15-17||
śyāmātrivṛtkaṣāyeṇa snukkṣīraghṛtaphāṇitaiḥ| lehaṃ paktvā ‘kṛtvā’ iti pā. virekārthaṃ lehayenmātrayā naram||18||
śyāmetyādinā lehayogamāha| mātrayeti anapāyimātrayā||18||

div.ab: pāyayettu sudhākṣīraṃ yūṣairmāṃsarasairghṛtaiḥ|19|
pāyayedityādinā pṛthagyūṣamāṃsarasaghṛtairyogatrayamāha|19|

ab.seg: bhāvitāñchuṣkamatsyān vā māṃsaṃ vā bhakṣayennaraḥ||19||
bhāvitānityādinā śuṣkamatsyamāṃsayogāvāha||19||
kṣīreṇāmalakaiḥ sarpiścaturaṅgulavat pacet| surāṃ vā kārayet kṣīre ghṛtaṃ vā pūrvavat pacet||20||

kṣīreṇetyādinā ekaṃ ghṛtam| ghṛtaṃ vetyādinā ekaṃ vakṣyati| āmalakaiścaturaṅgulavaditi vacanādāmalakarasayuktaṃ yaccaturaṅgulakalpe “caturaṅgulasiddhādvā” (ka.a.8) ityādinoktaṃ tasya vidhānamatidiśati| surāṃ vā kārayet kṣīre iti snukkṣīrabhāvitamityādividhinā surāṃ kuryāt| ghṛtaṃ vā pūrvavat pacedityatra pūrvavadityanena tilvakakalpe pūrvaṃ yat “lodhrakalkena” (ka.a.9) ityādigranthavihitaṃ, tadvidhireva pratyāsannatvādatidiśyate||20||
tatra ślokau- sauvīrakādibhiḥ sapta sarpiṣā ca rasena ca| pānakaṃ ghreyalehau ca yogā yūṣādibhistrayaḥ||21||
dvau śuṣkamatsyamāṃsābhyāṃ suraikā dve ca sarpiṣī| mahāvṛkṣasya yogāste viṃśatiḥ samudāhṛtāḥ||22||
sauvīraketyādiḥ saṅgraho vyākṛta eva||21-22||
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne sudhākalpo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ||10||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne sudhākalpo nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ||10||
athātaḥ saptalāśaṅkhinīkalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||2||
saptalā carmasāhvā ca bahuphenarasā ca sā| śaṅkhinī tiktalā caiva ‘tiktakā jñeyā’ iti, ‘tiktanālā ca’ iti ca pā. yavatiktā'kṣi(kṣa)pīḍakaḥ||3||
pūrvādhyāyoktasambandhādeva saptalāśaṅkhinīkalpo'bhidhīyate| iha cādhyāye ye yogā abhidhīyante te saptalayā vā śaṅkhinyā vā ubhābhyāṃ vā sampādyante śyāmātrivṛdyogavat||1-3||
te gulmagarahṛdrogakuṣṭhaśophodarādiṣu| vikāsitīkṣṇarūkṣatvādyojye śleṣmādhikeṣu tu||4||
nātiśuṣkaṃ phalaṃ grāhyaṃ śaṅkhinyā nistuṣīkṛtam| saptalāyāśca mūlāni gṛhītvā bhājane kṣipet||5||
te gulmetyādi| te saptalāśaṅkhinyau||4-5||
akṣamātraṃ tayoḥ piṇḍaṃ prasannālavaṇāyutam| hṛdroge kaphavātotthe ‘hṛdrogakaphavātārte’ iti pā. gulme caiva prayojayet||6||
priyālapīlukarkandhukolāmrātakadāḍimaiḥ| drākṣāpanasakharjūrabadarāmlaparūṣakaiḥ||7||
maireye dadhimaṇḍe'mle sauvīrakatuṣodake| sīdhau cāpyeṣa kalpaḥ syāt sukhaṃ śīghravirecanaḥ||8||

akṣamātramityādinā kalkasya prasannālavaṇayuktasya priyālādikaṣāyeṣu ṣoḍaśayogā bhavanti| atra yadyapi maireyaikṣavau na kaṣāyau tathā'pi bahukaṣāyāntargatatvāt kaṣāyāveva vaktavyau, saṅgrahe ‘kaṣāyā daśa ṣaṭ’ ityanena vyapadiṣṭau| kaṣāyaśabdena kalkakaṣāyo'bhipretaḥ| karkandhūkolabadaraśabdena triprakārabadaragrahaṇam||6-8||
tailaṃ vidārigandhādyaiḥ payasi kvathite pacet| saptalāśaṅkhinīkalke trivṛcchyāmārdhabhāgike||9||
dadhimaṇḍena sannīya siddhaṃ tat pāyayeta ca| śaṅkhinīcūrṇabhāgau dvau tilacūrṇasya ‘nīlīcūrṇasya cāparaḥ’ iti pā. cāparaḥ||10||
harītakīkaṣāyeṇa tailaṃ tatpīḍitaṃ pibet| atasīsarṣapairaṇḍakarañjaṣveṣa saṃvidhiḥ||11||

tailamityādinā prathamastailayogaḥ| trivṛcchyāmārdhabhāgike iti saptalāśaṅkhinīkalkayorardhabhāgena trivṛcchyāmākalko deyaḥ| śaṅkhinītyādinā pañcatailayogānāha, evaṃ ṣaṭtailayogā bhavanti| tailaṃ tatpīḍitamiti śaṅkhinīcūrṇaṃ tilacūrṇaṃ ca harītakīkaṣāyeṇa sandhāya ‘sannīya’ iti pā. pīḍitaṃ tat tailaṃ pibediti| atasyādiṣveṣa saṃvidhiriti vacanena tilasthāne'tasyādīnāṃ prayogaṃ vidhatte||9-11||
śaṅkhinīsaptalāsiddhāt kṣīrādyadudiyādghṛtam| kalkabhāge tayoreva trivṛcchyāmārdhasaṃyute||12||
kṣīreṇāloḍya sampakvaṃ ‘vipacet’ iti pā. pibettacca virecanam| dantīdravantyoḥ kalpo'yamajaśṛṅgyajagandhayoḥ||13||
kṣīriṇyā nīlikāyāśca ‘syāt kṣīriṇīnīlikayoḥ’ iti pā. tathaiva ca karañjayoḥ| masūravidalāyāśca pratyakparṇyāstathaiva ca||14||
dvivargārdhāṃśakalkena tadvat sādhyaṃ ghṛtaṃ punaḥ| śaṅkhinīsaptalādhātrīkaṣāye sādhayedghṛtam ‘cāparaṃ smṛtam’ iti pā.||15||
trivṛtkalpena sarpiśca trayo lehāśca lodhravat ‘pūrvavat’ iti pā.| surākampillayoryogaḥ kāryo lodhravadeva ca||16||

śaṅkhinīsaptaletyādi prathamaṃ ghṛtam| dantīdravantyorityādinā dvidvidravyakalkena saptalāśaṅkhinīkalkārdhena pūrvaghṛtavatpākācca pañcaghṛtayogā apare| dravantī dantībhedaḥ| ajaśṛṅgī viṣāṇikā| kṣīriṇī dugdhikā| masūravidalā śyāmalatā| pratyakparṇī mūṣikaparṇī| dvivargārdhāṃśakalkeneti dantyādidvivargaśaṅkhinīsaptalārdhabhāgikena kalkena| śaṅkhinītyādinā saptamaṃ ghṛtaṃ, trivṛtkalkenetyādyaṣṭamaṃ ghṛtam| atra tvadhikṛtatvāt saptalāśaṅkhinyordviguṇaḥ kaṣāyo vidhīyate| lodhravaditi lodhrakalpavat; lodhrakalpe yathā trayo lehāḥ “caturaṅgulakalpena” (ka.a.9) ityādinoktāḥ, tena lodhrasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīyogaḥ kartavyaḥ| tathā surāyogaḥ kampillayogaśca lodhravaditi atrāpi lodhrasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīprakṣepaḥ kartavyaḥ||12-16||
dantīdravantyoḥ kalpena sauvīrakatuṣodake| ajagandhājaśṛṅgyośca tadvat ‘kārye syātāṃ’ iti pā. syātāṃ virecane||17||

dantīdravantyorityādinā sandhānacatuṣṭayamāha| etat sandhānacatuṣṭayaṃ pūrvasurāyogena samaṃ ‘pañca madye” iti vacanena saṅgrahagṛhītaṃ; sauvīrakādīnāṃ ca madyaśabdenābhidhānamihāsūtatvasāmānyājjñeyam| dantīdravantyoḥ kalpeneti anāgatāvekṣaṇena dantīdravantīkalpe sauvīrakatuṣodake ye vaktavye tadvidhānamihāpyatidiśati| tatra “ajagandhākaṣāyeṇa sauvīrakatuṣodake” (ka.a.12) iti vaktavyaṃ, tenehāpyajagandhākaṣāyayuktasaptalāśaṅkhinyoḥ sauvīrakatuṣodake kartavye| atra “tathā dantīdravantyośca kaṣāye sājagandhayoḥ| gauḍaḥ kāryo'jaśṛṅgyā ca sa vai sukhavirecanaḥ” (ka.a.12) ityanenoktasya gauḍāriṣṭasya dantīdravantīkalpoktasya vidhānamatidiśati||17||
tatra ślokau- kaṣāyā daśa ṣaṭ caiva ṣaṭ taile'ṣṭau ca sarpiṣi| pañca madye trayo lehā yogaḥ kampillake tathā||18||
saptalāśaṅkhinībhyāṃ te triṃśaduktā navādhikāḥ| yogāḥ siddhāḥ samastābhyāmekaśo'pi ca te hitāḥ||19||
kaṣāyā ityādisaṅgraho vyākṛtaḥ||18-19||
ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīkalpo nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||11||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāmāyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīkalpo nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ||11||

div.head: dantīdravantīkalpaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dantīdravantīkalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavānātreyaḥ||2||
pāriśeṣyāt dantīdravantīkalpo'bhidhīyate||1-2||

div.ab: dantyudumbaraparṇī syānnikumbho'tha mukūlakaḥ| dravantī nāmataścitrā nyagrodhī mūṣikāhvayā||3|| (tathā mūṣikaparṇī cāpyupacitrā ca śambarī| pratyakśreṇī sutaśreṇī dantī ra(ca)ṇḍā ca kīrtitā ayaṃ ślokaḥ kvacitpustake na paṭhyate )|

ab.seg: tayoḥ paryāyānāha- dantītyādi||3||
tayormūlāni saṅgṛhya sthirāṇi bahalāni ca| hastidantaprakārāṇi śyāvatāmrāṇi buddhimān||4||
sthirāṇīti sārabhūtāni| bahalānīti ghanatvakkāni| hastidantaprakārāṇīti antapūrvopacitāni| śyāvatāmrāṇīti yathākrameṇa dantyāḥ śyāvāni, dravantyāstāmrāṇi||4||
pippalīmadhuliptāni svedayenmṛtkuśāntare| śoṣayedātape'gnyarkau ‘śoṣayedātape'rkāgnī’ iti pā. hato hyeṣāṃ vikāśitām||5||

svedayenmṛtkuśāntara iti pippalīmadhukakalkābhyāṃ parilipya kuśaiḥ pariveṣṭya tato mṛdāvaliptāni svedayet| agnisvedātapaśoṣaṇaphalamāha- agnyarkau hato hyeṣāṃ vikāśitāmiti|- eṣāṃ dantīdravantīmūlānāṃ vikāśitālakṣaṇaṃ guṇaṃ svedopaśoṣaṇābhyāmagnyarkau hataḥ; tena nātidoṣāṇi dantīdravantīmūlāni syuriti bhāvaḥ||5||
tīkṣṇoṣṇānyāśukārīṇi vikāśīni gurūṇi ca| vilāyayanti doṣau dvau mārutaṃ kopayanti ca||6||
tīkṣṇoṣṇānītyādinā teṣāṃ guṇakathanam| doṣau dvāviti pittaśleṣmāṇau||6||
dadhitakrasurāmaṇḍaiḥ piṇḍamakṣasamaṃ tayoḥ| priyālakolabadarapīluśīdhubhireva ca||7||
pibedgulmodarī doṣairabhikhinnaśca ‘doṣairabhiṣyaṇṇaśca’ iti pā. yo naraḥ| gomṛgājarasaiḥ pāṇḍuḥ kṛmikoṣṭhī bhagandarī||8||
tayoḥ kalke kaṣāye ca daśamūlarasāyute| kakṣyālajīvisarpeṣu ‘visarpālajikakṣyāsu’ iti pā. dāhe ca vipacedghṛtam||9||
tailaṃ mehe ca gulme ca sodāvarte kaphānile| catuḥsnehaṃ śakṛcchukravātasaṅgānilārtiṣu||10||
rase dantyajaśṛṅgayośca guḍakṣaudraghṛtānvitaḥ| lehaḥ siddho virekārthe dāhasantāpamehanut ‘deyaḥ santāpamehanut’ iti pā.||11||
vātatarṣe jvare paitte syāt sa evājagandhayā| dantīdravantyormūlāni pacedāmalakīrase||12||
trīṃstu tasya kaṣāyasya bhāgau dvau phāṇitasya ca| tapte sarpiṣi taile vā bharjayettatra cāvapet||13||
kalkaṃ dantīdravantyośca śyāmādīnāṃ ca bhāgaśaḥ| tatsiddhaṃ prāśayellehaṃ sukhaṃ tena viricyate||14||

dadhītyādinā saptabhirdravyaiḥ saptaprayogānāha| śīdhuśabdaḥ priyālādibhiścaturbhiḥ pṛthak sambadhyate| abhikhinna iti ākrāntaḥ| gomṛgājarasairityatrāpi ‘piṇḍamakṣasamaṃ tayoḥ’ ityanuvartate| atrāpi gavādirasaistribhistrayaḥ prayogā bhavanti| tayorityādinā trīn snehayogānāha| anayoḥ kalkakaṣāyeṇa daśamūlarasatulyabhāgena ghṛtaṃ pacedvisarpādiṣu, tailaṃ tu pūrvavanmehādiṣu, catuḥ snehaṃ tu śakṛcchukravātasaṅgādiṣu| rase ityādinā eko lehaḥ| vātatarṣe ityādinā dvitīyaḥ| sa evājagandhayetyanena pūrvoktalehe evājaśṛṅgīsthāne'jagandhādānaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ khyāpayati| dantītyādinā tṛtīyo lehaḥ| bhāgaśa iti pratyekabhāgagrahaṇena| evametadantaiḥ prayogairādyaḥ ṣoḍaśako bhavet||7-14||
rase ca daśamūlasya tathā baibhītake rase| harītakīrase caiva lehānevaṃ pacet pṛthak ‘bhiṣak’ iti pā.||15||
tayorbilvasamaṃ cūrṇaṃ tadraseneva bhāvitam| asṛṣṭe viśi vātotthe gulme cāmlayutaṃ śubham||16||
pāṭayitvekṣukāṇḍaṃ vā kalkenālipya cāntarā| svedayitvā tataḥ ‘naraḥ’ iti pā. khādet sukhaṃ tena viricyate||17||
mūlaṃ dantīdravantyośca saha mudgairvipācayet| lāvavartīrakādyaiśca ‘lāvatittirikābhyāṃ ca’ iti pā. te rasāḥ syurvirecane||18||
tayorvā'pi kaṣāyeṇa yavāgūṃ jāṅgalaṃ rasam| māṣayūṣaṃ ‘māṃsaṃ yūṣāṃśca’ iti pā. ca saṃskṛtya dadyāttaiśca viricyate||19||

rase cetyādai evamityanena pūrvoktalehatrayamatidiśati| tayorityādikaścaturthaḥ; tayoriti dantīdravantīmūlayoḥ| asṛṣṭe iti vibaddhe| pāṭayitvetyādinā pañcamaḥ| kalkenālipya cāntareti dantīdravantīkalkena pāṭitekṣukāṇḍamadhye ālipya| mūlaṃ dantītyādinā'ṣṭau kṛtākṛtarasānāha| atra lāvavartīrakādayaḥ “lāvo vartīrakaścaiva vārtīkaḥ sakapiñjalaḥ| cakoraścopacakraśca kakubho raktacarmakaḥ” (sū.a.27) iti granthenāṣṭāvuktāḥ; teṣāṃ pratyekayogādaṣṭau rasā bhavanti| tayorvā'pītyādinā yavāgūjāṅgalarasayogaṃ māṣayūṣayogaṃ cāha| evametairdravaiḥ pūrvayogaiśca militvā dvitīyaḥ ṣoḍaśako bhavet||15-19||
tatkaṣāyāttrayo bhāgā dvau sitāyāstathaiva ca| eko godhūmacūrṇānāṃ kāryā ‘kāryaiṣotkārikā’ iti pā. cotkārikā śubhā||20||
modako vā'sya kalpena ‘kalkena’ iti pā. kāryastacca virecanam| tayoścāpi kaṣāyeṇa madyānyasyopakalpayet||21||
dantīkvāthena cāloḍya ‘dantīkaṣāyairlulitān’ iti pā. dantītailena sādhitān| guḍalāvaṇikān bhakṣyān vividhān bhakṣayennaraḥ||22||
dantīṃ dravantīṃ maricaṃ yavānīmupakuñcikām| nāgaraṃ hemadugdhāṃ ca citrakaṃ ceti cūrṇitam||23||
saptāhaṃ bhāvayenmūtre gavāṃ pāṇitalaṃ tataḥ| pibetghṛtena jīrṇe ‘cūrṇa’ iti pā. tu viriktaścāpi tarpaṇam||24||
sarvarogaharaṃ mukhyaṃ sarveṣvṛtuṣu yaugikam| cūrṇaṃ tadanapāyitvādbālavṛddheṣu pūjitam||25||
durbhaktājīrṇapārśvārtigulmaplīhodareṣu ca| gaṇḍamālāsu vāte ‘gaṇḍamālāsravāte ca’ iti pā. ca pāṇḍuroge ca śasyate||26||
palaṃ citrakadantyośca harītakyāśca viṃśatiḥ| trivṛtpippalikarṣau dvau guḍasyāṣṭapalena tat||27||
vinīya modakān kuryāddaśaikaṃ bhakṣayettataḥ| uṣṇāmbu ca pibeccānu ‘pibeccheṣān’ iti pā. daśame daśame'hni ca||28||
ete niṣparihārāḥ syuḥ sarvaroganibarhaṇāḥ| grahaṇīpāṇḍurogārśaḥkaṇḍūkoṭhānilāpahāḥ||29||
dantīdvipalaniryūho drākṣārdhaprasthasādhitaḥ ‘drākṣārdhaprasthasaṃyutaḥ’ iti pā.| virecanaṃ pittakāse pāṇḍuroge ca śasyate||30||
dantīkalkaṃ samaguḍaṃ śītavāriyutaṃ pibet| virecanaṃ mukhyatamaṃ ‘etadvirecanaṃ mukhyaṃ’ iti pā. kāmalāharamuttamam||31||
śyāmādantīrase gauḍaḥ pippalīphalacitrakaiḥ| lipte'riṣṭo'nilaśleṣmaplīhapāṇḍūdarāpahaḥ||32||
tathā dantīdravantyośca kaṣāye sājagandhayoḥ| gauḍaḥ kāryo''jaśṛṅgyā vā sa ‘rase’ iti pā. vai sukhavirecanaḥ||33||
taccūrṇakvāthamāṣāmbukiṇvatoyasamudbhavā| madirā kaphagulmālpavahnipārśvakaṭigrahe||34||
ajagandhākaṣāyeṇa sauvīrakatuṣodake| surākampillake yogau lodhravacca tayoḥ smṛtau||35||

tatkaṣāyādityādinā utkārikāyogaṃ modakayogaṃ cāha| tatkaṣāyāditi dantīdravantīkaṣāyāt| modakakaraṇe'pi tatkaṣāyāttrayo bhāgā ityādividhānamanuvartate| tayoścāpi kaṣāyeṇa madyānīti tṛtīyaḥ| dantītyādinā bhakṣyayogaścaturthaḥ| dantīṃ dravantīṃ maricamityādikaḥ pañcamaḥ| hemadugdhā svarṇakṣīrī| cūrṇitamityantaṃ pibediti sambandhaḥ| palamityādikaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ| harītakyāśca viṃśatiriti ākṛtimānena| ayaṃ yogastantrāntare “agastyamodaka” iti khyātaḥ| dantīdvipaletyādikaḥ saptamaḥ| atra dantīdvipaladrākṣārdhaprasthayoḥ kvāthaḥ kartavyaḥ| dantīkalkamityādiko'ṣṭamaḥ| śyāmetyādiko navamaḥ| gauḍa iti guḍaprakṛtikaḥ| lipte ityatra ‘ghaṭe’ iti śeṣaḥ| tathā dantīdravantyoścetyādiko daśamaḥ| tathetyanena pūrvayogoktapippalyādighaṭāvalepa atidiśyate| ajaśṛṅgyā vetyādika ekādaśaḥ| tathā ajaśṛṅgyā dantīdravantyośca kaṣāye gauḍo'riṣṭaḥ kārya iti sambandhaḥ| taccūrṇetyādiko dvādaśaḥ| atra tayordantīdravantyoścūrṇakvāthābhyāṃ tathā māṣāmbunā kiṇvakaraṇapūrvakaṃ yā surā kṛtā tatsurodbhavā madirā kartavyeti vākyārthaḥ| ajagandhetyādinā yogadvayamāha| tatrājagandhākaṣāyeṇa dantīdravantībhyāṃ sauvīrakatuṣodake kartavye| suretyādinā'paraṃ yogadvayamāha| lodhravacca tayoriti yathā lodhrakalpeṣu “surā lodhrakaṣāyeṇa” ityādinā surā proktā, tathā “kampillakakaṣāyeṇa” (ka.a.9) ityādinā kampillakayoga uktaḥ, tathā tayorapi dantīdravantyorlodhrasthāne prakṣepāt surāyogaḥ sauvīrakatuṣodakavidhānenaiva kartavyaḥ| iti tṛtīyaḥ ṣoḍaśakaḥ||20-35||
tatra ślokāḥ- (dadhyādiṣu trayaḥ pañca priyālādyaistrayo rase| sneheṣu vai trayo lehyāḥ ṣaṭ cūrṇe tveka eva ca||36||
ikṣāvekastathā mudgamāṃsānāṃ ca rasāstrayaḥ| yavāgvādau trayaścaiva ukta utkārikāvidhau||37||
ekaśca modake madye caikastatkvāthatailake| cūrṇamekaṃ punaścaiko modakaḥ pañca cāsave||38||
ekaḥ sauvīrake'thaiko yogaḥ syāttu tuṣodake| ekā suraikaḥ kampille tathā pañca ghṛte smṛtāḥ etacchlokacatuṣṭayaṃ hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate )||39||
dantīdravantīkalpe'smin proktāḥ ṣoḍaśakāstrayaḥ| nānāvidhānāṃ yogānāṃ bhaktidoṣāmayānprati||40||
